babylon crossfit.name: Crystal

babylon crossfit.name: Emily Dickson

Thank you to all the coaches and the members that have pushed me each step of the way! Highly recommend

crossfit nyc.name: Şerif Kaya Çınar
crossfit nyc.text: Great place. They have all needed equipment in abundance for both CrossFit and hyrox trainings. Trainers explain all movements in detail. The place has  lockers. crossfit nyc.name: Leandro Paul Iacono
crossfit nyc.text:
$50 for a single drop-in. Which is a shame. We need more people practicing this sport, and it's just seems like you want to discourage people from coming in. I understand it's NYC, but your monthly is $199. I've paid more a month at other boxes in other cities... But I don't think $50 for 45min is fair. It's my humble opinion in case the feedback can help you improve. Can't speak for coaches or location as I promptly walked out due to pricing.

Update: move to three stars after a chat with staff. They explained the reality of pricing in NYC and I can be empathetic to that, as it's not entirely their fault NYC is this expensive. I wish this weren't the case so we could have more people in CrossFit gyms.

crossfit south brooklyn.name: K. S.
crossfit south brooklyn.text: A very special place on our planet with first class coaches and humans. Skull and crossbones for life 🖤 🗽

crossfit south brooklyn.name: Jana Baumgartner
crossfit south brooklyn.text: I have trained in CrossFit gyms across the world and this one was one of the best and most welcoming. The group and coach was super supportive. Got the best feedback ever on my hang power clean. Went for only one drop in unfortunately as I was travelling for work. However, that one was 10/10 and 100% worth it!
crossfit south brooklyn.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks for the kind words, Jana. Please come back when you're in town and remember to keep your knees back and shoulders forward on your hang clean set up. 😉

crossfit south brooklyn.name: Gal
crossfit south brooklyn.text: Amazing staff with excellent Crossfit classes. Came for a drop-in and enjoyed it so much.

crossfit 718.name: Hamid Soleymani
crossfit 718.text: I recently joined CrossFit 718 as a complete beginner, and I have to give a huge shoutout to coaches Tammy and Vincent. Their expertise, enthusiasm, and patience make every workout fun and motivating. They have great knowledge and focus on proper form, which have been invaluable in helping me progress safely and effectively. Classes usually have 5-6 people, so expect to get lots of individual attention. Overall, CrossFit 718 has an incredibly supportive and dynamic environment. If you're a total beginner adult (like myself!) or looking for exceptional coaches, I highly recommend this box!
crossfit 718.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for your positive review!
We look forward to working with you during your CrossFit journey.

crossfit 718.name: Wes Lumpkin
crossfit 718.text: Coach Iz has been solid since the first day I walked in to inquire. Love the work outs and instruction around the exercises/ movements. Coach Tammy’s morning classes are also good starts to the day!
crossfit 718.responseFromOwnerText: That's what's up, thanks for the love, KEEP COMING!

crossfit result.name: Xueqi Qu
crossfit result.text: It‘s my first time trying crossfit. The coaches here are very very nice and professional. Classmates in group classes are also very nice and friendly. It is an amazing gym! I had great time here this summer when doing my internship nearby. I will miss the gym!
crossfit result.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you snow! We will miss having you in the gym. We hope to see you again soon!!!

crossfit result.name: Sandy Iannarone
crossfit result.text: Best gym, hands down.  Not only is the facility huge, its also incredibly clean and laid out to maximize the size.  The equipment is top notch--there is nothing you need that they do not provide.  The coaches are knowledgeable, invested and helpful but also just really good people who inspire you to believe in yourself and push a little harder than you think you can.   The DNA of the gym is  is welcoming, friendly and supportive regardless of your personal or fitness backgrounds.  My only regret is not joining the CF Result family sooner!

crossfit | sunnyside strong.name: Jihra Gavilanes
crossfit | sunnyside strong.text: I have extensive CF experience. Tried joining but they asked me to schedule a consultation. The “owner” tried to get me to sign up to some $500 30 day kick start that includes all kinds of things that I don’t need or want. I was simply looking to join their CrossFit group classes as I into the neighborhood and needed a new CrossFit gym. They do have online $209 membership but insisted I needed to buy their $500 membership first. Crazy
crossfit | sunnyside strong.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Jihra,

Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. 

At CrossFit Sunnyside, every new member—whether a beginner or someone with years of CrossFit experience—starts with a complimentary consultation so we can learn about their goals, fitness background, and any limitations before jumping into group training. The free consultation is also an opportunity for you to learn about our program, how it is structured, and how it might be different from other gyms.

Our onboarding process for all new members includes personal training sessions to assess individual strengths and areas for growth. This ensures each athlete’s training is safe, personalized, and appropriately challenging. The cost of these sessions is built into our introductory membership plans, such as our 30-Day QuickStart or 90-Day Kickstart, which help each athlete build a foundation for success.

We never want anyone to feel pressured—our goal is to make sure every person who joins us fully understands what we offer and that it’s a great fit for both sides. The $209 membership you referenced becomes available after completing the intro phase, once athletes have been safely integrated into our program.

We wish you the best in finding a gym that aligns with your needs, and we appreciate the opportunity to clarify our process for others considering joining our community.

— The CrossFit Sunnyside Team

crossfit middle village.name: KC W
crossfit middle village.text: Great place offering group and individual classes. Kids to adults. Flexible terms. Professional and friendly staff.

crossfit middle village.responseFromOwnerText: Daniela thank you so much for reviewing! We appreciate you and look forward to seeing you crush your fitness journey!

crossfit ozp.name: Jasvir Kaur
crossfit ozp.text: This is not a good place they will use your picture to promote their ozp special Jimmy the owner i was a member their for over 4 years  i lost some weight by taking weight lost injection and jimmy me do the interview  and I did i am so sorry about the interview they use me and told audience I lost the weight because of the crossfitozp which is not true I told many times to remove my videos from your Instagram they don't want to very bad
crossfit ozp.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Jasvir, 

Thank you for your 4 years of dedication to CrossFit OZP. We truly value the time you spent as a member of our community, and it is saddening to hear that external insecurities have impacted your perspective on your journey with us. 

Regarding your concerns about social media, we want to clarify that we have fully complied with your initial requests. Although you signed a media waiver upon joining that granted us permission to share your progress, we immediately honored your request to remove your pictures and videos from our Instagram. 

Please understand that fulfilling this request meant permanently deleting many posts that featured other members and cherished community memories. We did this out of respect for your wishes despite the impact on our digital archive. 

We are proud of the work you put in over the years at CrossFit OZP and sincerely wish you the best on your health and wellness journey. 

Best Regards, 

The CrossFit OZP Team

crossfit ozp.name: Alisa Astudillo
crossfit ozp.text:
OZP is more than just a gym, it’s a true community. I know everyone says that about their box, but at OZP it’s genuinely felt. The staff, coaches, and members all want you to succeed and support you every step of the way. I’ve never felt as strong or as confident in myself as I do now.
What makes OZP special is that the community extends beyond the gym walls. We show up for run clubs, competitions, and visits to other boxes together. In the few years since I joined, I’ve made lifelong friends. And Coach Alex is truly the best! He’s knowledgeable, motivating, and always invested in helping you be your best.

crossfit momentum.name: Stacey Mcelroy
crossfit momentum.text: Love CrossFit Momentum!! I joined the weekly Sunday “MomFit” class and it has helped me so much!! Steph, Lauren, and Claudia have been so helpful and patient in their guidance around fitness & nutrition. I feel stronger already, and am more motivated to clean up my eating and other lifestyle habits!
crossfit momentum.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Stacey! We love having you and am so glad you're feeling both stronger and more motivated!

crossfit momentum.name: Ashley Holzel
crossfit momentum.text: I have 2 little kids and I haven’t worked out in years. All I want to do is build strength and endurance  to keep up with my little ones. Never would I ever consider joining a CF gym but I saw CFM was staring classes specifically for moms. This sounded way more manageable and more of a judgement-free zone so I figured I would give 1 class a try. Im now hooked! I’m only able to go one day a week, but I genuinely look forward to going each week!! I don’t fear it like I used to fear a 100% cardio class. This is fun and pushes my body in ways that I can directly see can the results. Not to mention, The coaches and group of ladies I train with are all awesome strong mamas!
crossfit momentum.responseFromOwnerText:
This means so much Ashley, thanks for sharing 💗

Getting back into fitness with little ones at home is no small thing, and we're so proud of you for showing up each week! 

I love that it feels fun (not intimidating) and that you're seeing it carry over into every day life--that's exactly what MomFit is all about.

And you are right, this group of strong Mamas is super special, we are glad you are a part of it!

crossfit momentum.name: Kyomi Gregory (Dr. G)
crossfit momentum.text: I can’t say enough good things about my experience at CrossFit Momentum. I joined the MomFit group after having a baby 11 months ago. The coaches are meeting me where I’m at and bringing my fitness to the next level. I used to be terrified of CrossFit and now I look forward to every workout.
crossfit momentum.responseFromOwnerText:
We truly appreciate you sharing this Kyomi!
Returning to fitness after having a baby is such a big step, and it means a lot to know you feel supported and met exactly where you’re at.
That’s exactly what we aim for with MomFit—a space where postpartum moms can rebuild strength, gain confidence, and feel comfortable every step of the way.
And hearing that CrossFit went from something intimidating to something you look forward to is the best part.
So happy to have you with us!

dean crossfit.name: Janelle Pitterson
dean crossfit.text:
Walking into CrossFit for the first time, I truly didn’t know what to expect, but from the moment I stepped into Dean CrossFit, it felt less like a gym and more like walking into a family you didn’t know you had yet.

There’s an immediate warmth in the space. People are open, kind, and generous with what they know. As someone completely new, even the small things like where equipment lives, how the class flows, and what you’re responsible for can feel intimidating, but no one made it feel that way. Instead, there was a sense of community, encouragement, and shared effort that made me feel welcome right away.

Coach Juan was my very first introduction to CrossFit, and I truly couldn’t have asked for a better one. From day one, he made the experience feel approachable and supportive.
When I arrived early for my second class, he took time--before the workout even began--to walk me through positioning, breathing, and technique, especially for deadlifts. He explained what I should be paying attention to in my own body so I could move safely and confidently. Injury prevention was clearly a priority for him, not just something mentioned in passing.

Juan has a calm, grounding presence, but he doesn’t let you coast. He pushes you to meet your best effort while still honoring your body. Even though the class is group-based, his coaching feels individualized. He’s present, attentive, and genuinely invested in seeing people succeed not just get through the workout.

By my second class, with instruction from Chris as well, I could see how consistent and intentional the coaching is at Dean CrossFit. Chris has an incredible ability to spot small details, correct form, and help you tap into strength you didn’t even realize you had. That’s truly his gift! I ended up deadlifting 20 lbs heavier than I ever thought possible at the start of the workout. I felt challenged, supported, and genuinely encouraged every step of the way--not just by the coaches, but by the entire class.

Dean CrossFit gives you more than a great workout (and you definitely leave feeling accomplished). It gives you community, thoughtful coaching, and a space where you feel cared for from the moment you walk in. As someone new, that mattered deeply to me and it’s the reason I’m excited to keep coming back. I guess, I'm a crossfit girl now!

dean crossfit.name: Anna-Lisa Bjorklund
dean crossfit.text: I was visiting Brooklyn and dropped in Dean CF.  I travel quite a bit and as a result have trained in many different gyms — they are not created equal. crossfit queens.name: Barrett House
crossfit queens.text: Here is my attempt at a testimonial, if I could ever tell someone why they should start doing crossfit or just getting in better shape in general: it's so that they can travel, and particularly in the way I've been traveling the past couple of weeks. I have been thanking my past self for making the decision at the beginning of the year to 1) stop drinking 2) start exercising and eating clean again and 3) joining Crossfit Queens this last summer. I've traveled and taken trips before -- although this has certainly been the biggest, most real trip I've ever undertaken -- but that was when I was younger and invincible (or at least felt invincible). I celebrated my 37th birthday last week in Spain and I put these somewhat old bones through the ringer. Traveling can be a physically taxing activity, especially when approached with a wild mentality: unsure of where I'd be sleeping some nights, lugging my life around on my back from accommodation to accommodation, city to city, country to country, running to catch trains and planes, exploring new areas, doing handstands on the beach to impress some girls, racing my buddy in the ocean, even simple tasks like climbing in and out of baths without slipping and falling, or crawling in and out of a bunk bed in a hostel dorm room. The fear of being stitched up while on the road because of a stupid injury has grown as I've gotten older but I wasn't as concerned this trip because I'd been taking better care of myself. Stretching and lifting and running allowed me to really get after it these last couple of weeks. I wanted to find affiliates to drop into but there was always something to do, somewhere to go, or just necessary moments of rest. But I did manage to stretch and do press ups here and there (helped me stay zen when I was trying to sort out a flight change on the phone). Being complemented by friends from almost a decade ago because of how I looked, being able to dance all night at my friend's wedding, and at his wedding after party, and other than feeling tired from the madness I actually felt pretty great and I know that joining up and going to classes is a very big part of that. I was able to travel to Poland, Germany and Spain, go all day, very little sleep, last one to crash, first one to rise and it's because I was in better shape than I was last year. And now there are plans in the works for a big trip stateside in April and I'm immensely excited for the progress I hope to make between now and then. Back off the booze (Polish wedding and meeting up with old friends, had to get some pints in), eat clean and stretch, and try to really push myself during upcoming classes to maximize what I think I could be. The ultimate goal will be the ability to continue to travel in this manner for as long as I can, and being fit is key. Long ramble, but wanted to give an update, and to say thank you to all of the great coaches for helping me be better prepared for what was a trip of a lifetime. I'll be back in class next week. Definitely want to stay on this path

westchester fit.name: Oliver Bevan
westchester fit.text: Dropped in for a morning WOD. Really welcoming community, easy to register/set up. Great coaching / cues on handstand walks (thank you!)

crossfit seize the day.name: Rocky Bryant
crossfit seize the day.text: Lovely place! The coaches are very nice 🙂‍↔️. Very community centered.

crossfit seize the day.name: Alejandra Perez
crossfit seize the day.text:
Joining CrossFit Seize the Day in 2024 has honestly been one of the best decisions for me and my family. From day one, Coach Jeff and his wife Kathy have been incredibly welcoming not just to me, but to my husband, our kids, and even our friends who’ve come along.

What really sets this gym apart is the sense of community. It’s not just a place to work out it’s a place where you feel supported, encouraged, and genuinely cared for. Whether you’re new or experienced, everyone is made to feel like they belong.

The coaching is top-notch, the environment is motivating, and the people make it special. So grateful to be part of this community!💕🙏

empire state crossfit.name: camille ley
empire state crossfit.text: I was totally new to CrossFit when I joined Empire State CrossFit over a year ago, and it ended up being such a great experience. The training was a blast, and the coaches were awesome. Highly recommend if you want a fun and supportive place to train!

empire state crossfit.name: Billy Roosen
empire state crossfit.text: Everything about this gym is top notch. Coaching, programming, facility and most importantly the community. If you live in the Mamaroneck area and have been thinking of joining a gym, Empire delivers!

crossfit dynamix.name: Phil W
crossfit dynamix.text:
Love the gym.  Great community and the coaches are always nice and helpful.
Challenging programming with scaled option!

crossfit dynamix.name: Rusmaldo Faccio
crossfit dynamix.text: Friendly coaches nice atmosphere great workouts

crossfit merrick.name: Robert Willgoos
crossfit merrick.text: The workouts were great, but the coaches only care about the elite athletes and long timers. New members are just tolerated. I learned a lot though.
crossfit merrick.responseFromOwnerText: Hi Robert. I saw your review. I’m sorry we didn’t get to have a conversation about this and I apologize you felt this way. Why wouldnt you tell me how you felt?

evf performance & crossfit upper east si.name: Catherine Tavello
evf performance & crossfit upper east si.text: Amazing gym! Has everything you could ever need and great environment!

evf performance & crossfit upper east si.name: Julia Groberio
evf performance & crossfit upper east si.text:
Absolute best workout experience. From the moment you walk in, you can feel the energy and sense of community. It’s not just a gym, it’s a place where people genuinely support each other and want to see one another improve!

The coaches are incredibly knowledgeable, attentive, and motivating. They take the time to correct form, offer modifications when needed, and push you in a way that feels empowering, not intimidating. Whether you’re brand new to CrossFit or more experienced, they meet you where you are and help you get stronger every week.

What really sets EVF apart is the community. Everyone is welcoming, encouraging, and positive. It makes showing up for early mornings or tough workouts so much easier when you’re surrounded by great people.

If you’re looking for a gym that challenges you, supports you, and makes working out something you actually look forward to, EVF is it!!!

Highly recommend!

the body blueprint.name: Rachel B
the body blueprint.text: LOVE this gym. Gerard is a great trainer & the folks who come in for group classes are great. Everyone’s ready to go in and get to work. Highly recommend whether you’re a beginner or already active.

the body blueprint.name: Heidi Stenzel
the body blueprint.text:
Excellent experience at The Body Blueprint!
The Body Blueprint was recommended to me by Kristina, who is also an employee there as well as a friend, and I’m really glad I gave it a try. I took Suzette’s 5 AM strength and conditioning class, and it was a great welcome back after not doing CrossFit-style training for about two years. The environment was friendly, supportive, and not intimidating at all. I’d definitely recommend The Body Blueprint to anyone looking to start or restart their fitness journey.

radd fitness, nutrition, and recovery.name: Alessandro Squarciafico
radd fitness, nutrition, and recovery.text: Ci siamo allenati alle RADD CROSSFIT per il nostro soggiorno a Glen Cove. Palestra eccellente, ottime attrezzature e proprietari super disponibili. La consigliamo a chiunque voglia allenarsi nei pressi di Glen Cove!💪🏽
radd fitness, nutrition, and recovery.textTranslated: We trained at RADD CROSSFIT during our stay in Glen Cove. Excellent gym, great equipment, and super helpful owners. We recommend it to anyone looking to work out near Glen Cove! 💪🏽
radd fitness, nutrition, and recovery.responseFromOwnerText: Grazie mille Alessandro per la splendida recensione e per aver scelto RADD CROSSFIT durante il vostro soggiorno a Glen Cove. Siamo felici che abbiate trovato la palestra e le attrezzature eccellenti e che i proprietari siano stati super disponibili. Grazie per la raccomandazione a chi cerca dove allenarsi nei dintorni. Vi aspettiamo di nuovo quando tornerete in zona.

radd fitness, nutrition, and recovery.name: Sofia Herrera Vega Centeno
radd fitness, nutrition, and recovery.text: The best place to do your workouts if you are in vacation for holidays and faraway of your country. Great and gentle people and great staff.
radd fitness, nutrition, and recovery.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much! We are so happy you chose us while staying in NY. Safe travels and you’re welcome back anytime!

radd fitness, nutrition, and recovery.name: Jourdan
radd fitness, nutrition, and recovery.text: Amazing CrossFit gym with coaches who care a lot about their community and members! I highly recommend. My best friend who I grew up with also goes here and cannot say enough. The owners put so much effort into their programming, community and the business. If you are looking for proper technique with Olympic lifting, CrossFit, nutrition or just a great workout look no further! This is the place for you!
radd fitness, nutrition, and recovery.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your kind words, Jourdan! We're thrilled to hear that you and your best friend have had such positive experiences with our coaches and community. Our team is dedicated to providing top-notch programming and support, and it's great to know it's making a difference. We appreciate your recommendation and look forward to seeing you in the gym!

willyb fitness - crossfit and group trai.name: Erin Miu
willyb fitness - crossfit and group trai.text: This has been my home box for years! Love the space and vibe- the coaches here are lovely. Great people come here! What makes this a great space is that you can drop weights- a lot of gyms in the city do not allow this (thank you basement gym!). I like that there are lots of options for class times.

willyb fitness - crossfit and group trai.name: Sapphira Bella
willyb fitness - crossfit and group trai.text: Awesome classes and instructors. I have come to classes here with JP, and the classes were very well thought out, well explained and challenging. Great place for a great workout.

willyb fitness - crossfit and group trai.name: Addison Cooper
willyb fitness - crossfit and group trai.text: WillyB turned my fitness routine into a lifestyle I love.

infinite crossfit yonkers.name: Jasmin Maldonado
infinite crossfit yonkers.text: Awesome work out! Attentive to his clients and results for sure!

infinite crossfit yonkers.name: Anthony Espinal
infinite crossfit yonkers.text:
My review is based on the multiple failed attempts to visit the gym and drop in on a class.

When you get to this location you’ll immediately see it’s an MMA gym, with a big arrow and “CrossFit Downstairs”. I’ve tried multiple times to drop in on a class and the times I visited the door the arrow was pointing to was locked. No one in sight to help. There is also no posted schedule of classes, just general hours open, that also fed into the confusion. I also tried calling the posted phone number that doesn’t seem to be in order so that didn’t help either.

Please contact me so I can know when and how to drop in on a class.

I’d gladly remove this review once I can successfully drop in.

dobbs ferry crossfit.name: Christian Gordon
dobbs ferry crossfit.text:
Amazing and welcoming community, top-notch coaches, excellent facilities, and well-thought-out programming. One of the best parts is their CrossFit Kids classes that run alongside adult classes, our whole family can work out at the same time.

I’ve been doing CrossFit for over 10 years, and as an Air Force veteran who’s lived in multiple places and trained at many boxes, I can confidently say DFCF is top tier. I joined about two years ago after moving back to Westchester and have been a regular at the 5AM classes ever since.

Whether you’re an experienced athlete or just getting started, if you’re in the river towns or lower Westchester, definitely drop in. You won’t be disappointed.

dobbs ferry crossfit.name: meaghan martin
dobbs ferry crossfit.text: In the last 10 years I’ve been doing CrossFit, dobbs is by far the best gym I’ve ever had the pleasure of being a member of. The atmosphere, members and coaches are fantastic!

dobbs ferry crossfit.name: Herberth Balsells
dobbs ferry crossfit.text:
If you’re looking for a CrossFit gym that truly checks all the boxes, this is the place. The programming is consistently well thought out—challenging without being overwhelming, and varied enough to keep things interesting week after week. Whether you’re a beginner or experienced athlete, the workouts strike a great balance between intensity, skill-building, and scalability.

The coaches are knowledgeable, attentive, and genuinely invested in helping everyone improve. They bring great energy to every class, making workouts not only effective but actually fun.

And then there is the community. The members are supportive, motivating, and inclusive, creating an environment where people push each other to be better while still having a good time. It’s the kind of place where you look forward to showing up—not just for the workout, but for the people.

crossfit hell's kitchen nyc.name: Ori Gerstel
crossfit hell's kitchen nyc.text:
Best box in nyc!
Very reasonable price for a weekly membership, professional staff, and killer workouts!
Highly recommended

crossfit hell's kitchen nyc.name: Eduardo Cali
crossfit hell's kitchen nyc.text:
Dropped in and loved everything about it.
From the moment i stepped in, Tom was great on every aspect. Guided me through the process and made me feel like home.
The community was also warming and friendly. Great coaching! Attention to detail and fun vibes

crossfit hell's kitchen nyc.name: Chad Marge
crossfit hell's kitchen nyc.text: this is the best place ever everyone should join. fantastic coaches, super sweet people, hard ass workouts. what more could you want?

matchpoint nyc.name: Anush04_ “Football_Diary”
matchpoint nyc.text: I don't recommend signing a contract with him, you won't be able to cancel this contract later.

matchpoint nyc.name: Elmira Sagatkyzy
matchpoint nyc.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your positive feedback!

- The MatchPoint NYC Team

peak 180 (crossfit peak180 athletics).name: Elizabeth Ferrigno
peak 180 (crossfit peak180 athletics).text:
Peak 180 is one of the best gyms I have ever been to! The coaching staff is extemely knowledgeable and super motivating providing excellent guidance and support. The coaches and members welcome you with open arms and are so so friendly and non judgmental!
I have been crossfitting on and off for 14 years and must say the programming here is nothing short of amazing. I love how the workouts have scalable options on push press so you can go into each workout with a game plan. They offer metabolic and strength training classes which compliment each other so well.  The best part about this gym isn’t just the workouts it’s the comradery (and all the dogs running around!!!!) It has reconnected me with friends I used to CrossFit with back in the day and I am forever grateful!!
peak 180 (crossfit peak180 athletics).responseFromOwnerText:
Wow!! Thank you so much for this incredible review. It truly means a lot, especially coming from someone with so many years in the CrossFit space. We take a lot of pride in thoughtful programming, intentional coaching, and creating scalable options so everyone can train with confidence and a clear plan.

What you said about the camaraderie is exactly what we hope to build here — strong workouts and even stronger connections (and yes… the dogs definitely help). We’re so grateful you’re part of Peak180 and love that it’s helped reconnect you with old friends. That’s what it’s all about.

peak 180 (crossfit peak180 athletics).name: Kef Louis
peak 180 (crossfit peak180 athletics).responseFromOwnerText: Thanks so much for the 5 stars! We’re glad you’re here and appreciate you being part of the Peak180 family.

peak 180 (crossfit peak180 athletics).name: CHRISTINE
peak 180 (crossfit peak180 athletics).text: Being going to peak for years, equipments are new, facility is big and clean. Staff and gym members are very welcoming and friendly.
peak 180 (crossfit peak180 athletics).responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for the kind words and for being with us all these years! We truly appreciate you and are grateful to have you as part of the Peak community. Members like you are what make this place so special. 💙💪

three hammers training.name: Kevin M
three hammers training.text: True community. Great atmosphere to better yourself. Great music played at the perfect volume.

9one4 crossfit.name: Elizabeth Winter
9one4 crossfit.text: This box has quickly become my go-to for drop-ins when I'm in town visiting family. It's a great space with a good variety of programming. The coaches are excellent and the community is really welcoming. Whether you're brand new to CrossFit or an experienced athlete or somewhere in between, you will find what you're looking for here. Highly recommend!

9one4 crossfit.name: perry hayes
9one4 crossfit.text: Great space.  Really good coaches welcoming community.

crossfit sunset park.name: John Whitman
crossfit sunset park.text: Love going to CFSP. Great community and coaches, makes working out fun. Can’t recommend enough!

crossfit sunset park.name: Michael Tom
crossfit sunset park.text: Everyone is very kind and welcoming of all levels. Highly recommend!

crossfit chief nation.name: L8K
crossfit chief nation.text: First time at a CrossFit gym in my life and I’d have to say that this gym is full of members and coaches that are dedicated to working hard, and getting results. What a positive atmosphere! I’d highly recommend this gym to anyone that is at all curious about CrossFit.
crossfit chief nation.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks for the fantastic review! We’re thrilled your first CrossFit experience felt supportive and motivating — our members and coaches work hard to create that environment. We appreciate your recommendation and look forward to helping you reach your fitness goals. See you in class soon.

crossfit chief nation.name: Samantha Barone
crossfit chief nation.text: I’d give Chief Nation 10 stars if I could! Jet and Julie have created such an amazing fitness community here. Everyone feels welcome! You are celebrated, supported and cheered on from everyone. The CrossFit community is lucky to have them. I love coming here when I come home to visit family and it’s like I never skipped a beat. No PB is too big or too small here which is an amazing feeling. If you’re up in the air about joining, let this be your sign to go sign up asap!!
crossfit chief nation.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for the amazing review, Samantha. Jet and Julie are thrilled to hear you feel celebrated, supported, and cheered on, and we’re so glad Chief Nation feels like home when you visit. Hearing that no PB feels too big or too small means everything to us. We can’t wait to welcome you back next time you're in town.

crossfit chief nation.name: nana bucaros
crossfit chief nation.text: I just join and I was a little scare but now I am in love. The atmosphere, the sense of community, the equipment and the staff members everything is awesome, they make you feel confident, secure and help you reach your goals little by little.
crossfit chief nation.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your wonderful feedback! We're thrilled to hear that you've found our atmosphere, community, and staff to be supportive and encouraging. Your journey towards your goals is important to us, and we're glad you're feeling confident and secure. We look forward to continuing to support you every step of the way!

cow harbor crossfit.name: Pam Angel
cow harbor crossfit.text: I was visiting family and did a drop-in visit to Cal harbor CrossFit. Wonderful place. Very friendly people. Excellent and and welcoming coaches.  I'll definitely go back again if I'm in town. I've posted today's WOD

cow harbor crossfit.name: José Roberto Alava guerrero
cow harbor crossfit.text: Hola soy de Ecuador y en mi país entrene en varios crossfit pero la comunidad de Cow Harbor Crossfit es increíble los profesores esta pendiente en ti que no falles me encanta entrenar CHC 100% recomendado 💪
cow harbor crossfit.textTranslated: Hi, I'm from Ecuador and I've trained at several CrossFit gyms in my country, but the Cow Harbor CrossFit community is incredible. The instructors are very attentive and make sure you don't let me down. I love training at CHC. 100% recommended 💪

cow harbor crossfit.name: Justin Oakley
cow harbor crossfit.text: I did two drop-ins here while visiting from Brooklyn and the classes were great! The WODs were fun and paced well. The coaches were very helpful and interactive. The members in my class also had great vibes! I will definitely be back whenever I'm in the area.

crossfit bridge & tunnel.name: Ryan Michael
crossfit bridge & tunnel.text: The community is supportive and kind, the couches are efficient yet take the time to engage with you one on one at whatever level you're at, also the on-boarding process is very helpful and structured so getting into the groove of things wasn't overwhelming at all. In the last year and a half I've lost over a hundred pounds and I'm now in the best shape of my life. Just one day at a time, and I have Bridge & Tunnel to thank!!!!

crossfit bridge & tunnel.name: Josh Cameron
crossfit bridge & tunnel.text: These coaches and people are great. It can be so hard to find a good gym. This is my second round here and happy I came back.  Cheers to the whole team and thanks for the push.

crossfit bridge & tunnel.name: Kewsi Burgess
crossfit bridge & tunnel.text:
Dropped in on the 7am class. It was well attended with friendly group of athletes and an energetic coach. Great programming-
I died during the workout, but regained consciousness just in time to write this review.
crossfit bridge & tunnel.responseFromOwnerText: 😂 Thank you Kewsi! We were happy to have you. Looking forward to coming back again. Happy New Year 🎊

rx fit.name: Laura Royse
rx fit.text: Fun kids classes. My son loved it!

rx fit.name: Jenny Chiu
rx fit.text: I took my first class today with Juliana.  She’s great! Very attentive and helped make sure I was doing all of the moves properly.  Great energy and kept the class fun.  Overall, just a really great person (and extremely fit!)

7384560215027197602.snippet:
I was a member of this gym years ago when it operated as Hollywood, and the experience back then was noticeably better. The layout made more sense, the space felt larger, and the overall environment was more comfortable for members.

After several difficult years recovering from injuries caused by multiple car accidents, I recently returned hoping to get back into a routine. I’m currently dealing with a herniated disc, scoliosis, muscle spasms, and joint instability, so I’m very careful about posture and body alignment while working out.

During a back workout, I had my shirt off for one full set so I could check my alignment and make sure my form was correct. In the middle of the set, someone approached me and told me to put my shirt back on because “this is a public place.” What made the interaction confusing was that he wasn’t wearing any type of staff uniform or identification—just a regular hoodie—so it wasn’t immediately clear that he was an employee.

After the interaction, I noticed him continuing to watch me from the side while walking through the gym and going in and out of the office area. It gave me the impression that I might be about to be reported or removed, which made the environment feel uncomfortable while I was simply trying to finish my workout.

To give credit where it’s due, the cardio section actually looks excellent. I didn’t get the chance to use it because I ended up feeling uncomfortable after the interaction, but from what I saw the equipment looked modern and well maintained. At least the machines appear to be in good working condition, which is something you don’t always see at other gyms.

That said, the layout and usable space compared to what this location used to offer is disappointing. The downstairs area, which seems intended for stretching or functional training, is extremely limited. Honestly, it looks worse than some small home gyms I’ve seen built in garages. For a membership around $75 per month, I expected a more functional layout and better use of space.

I returned because I had positive memories of this gym when it was Hollywood. Unfortunately, between the interaction with staff and the reduced space compared to before, the experience this time around left me disappointed.

I don’t know what kind of gym this place has turned into compared to what it used to be. What I do know is that it no longer feels like the kind of environment I want to be part of.

To me, the nature of a real gym is to lift people up—to support ambition, discipline, and self-improvement. A gym should be a place where people feel encouraged to push themselves and work on becoming healthier and stronger, not discouraged while trying to do exactly that.

response.snippet:
Hello Ron

First let me congratulate you for working thru the challenges of your health issues

I apologize for the request of putting your shirt back on during your workout but we do have signs posted around the gym for shirts to be in at all times. With that being said if the person did not have a Staff shirt on it probably was not a staff member as they must wear one while working at all times.

It is always a challenge to ensure everyone follows the rules of any gym and or business but we strive to make an environment that makes most happy.

We are the same management since doors were opened for Hollywood and protocols are pretty much the same since
We would live for you to give it another chance and if you decide to please contact me directly to get you back in the system at

Kingsandqueenshewlett@gmail.com

7384560215027197602.snippet:
I visited this gym a couple of times using a 3-day guest pass and had a great workout during each session. There’s a wide variety of machines targeting every muscle group, with different makes and models to choose from. The facility is very clean, well-organized, and clearly well-maintained. The staff are friendly and helpful, and there’s plenty of street parking right in front.
Whenever I’m in the area, this will definitely be my go-to spot to train. I highly recommend this gym to any fitness enthusiast or bodybuilder looking for a quality workout environment.

response.snippet: We appreciate you!

7384560215027197602.snippet:
Left a gym in LI to go to this one and happy I made the switch. A lot of machine, two floors with of equipment, dividers in between cardio machines, a powerlifting station, clean bathroom and much more. Price is great.

My only complaint is I wish they had some Atlantis and Panatta machine.And I wish people stop slamming the weight, destroying the floor, and the vibe was better.

People are amazing but doesn't have that "we are all here to do incredible things today" vibe.

response.snippet: We appreciate you and your feedback !

7384560215027197602.snippet:
This gym double-charged members for the month of October 2025 and never issued refunds or even bothered to properly communicate the mistake. On top of that, the restrooms are constantly dirty and clearly not maintained. For the price they charge every month, the value simply isn’t there — it’s not worth the expensive subscription.

EDIT(response to owner):
The gym did in fact send emails notifying members that we were double charged. However, they did not actually issue any refund and after sending THREE follow up emails with no response, I was forced to dispute the charge and leave this review. The sarcastic, rude, and unempathetic response from the owner shows just how little they care about their members.

response.snippet:
I am very sorry that you did not read the emails that were sent out by both The gym and the Software Company that had an internal issue

By no means was that response meant to be cold or sarcastic David
We were working daily to get all members refunded with the software company I promise you

7384560215027197602.snippet:
If you’re looking for a gym where EVERY single person actually gives a damn about your progress, stop scrolling, this is it!

This is not a “cute little gym.”
This is where excuses come to die and bodies get rebuilt.

From the moment you walk in, the front desk energy is elite, the vibe is locked in, the place is clean, organized, and you can FEEL that everyone here wants you to win. The manager, the staff, the ownership, I don’t want to call anyone out by name because every single one of them is built different in the best way. No egos, no attitude, just straight-up support and professionalism.

And let’s talk about the training here…
When you’re finally ready to lose that gut, tighten that butt, build real muscle, and actually look hot again, this is where you come. When you’re ready to stop playing games and turn that “pork” into a work of art, you don’t just get a trainer…
you get a real-life Incredible Hulk who forges humans into weapons. 💪🔥

This gym isn’t about trends. It’s about results, discipline, consistency, and real transformations. I’ve hit PRs, dropped serious weight 75pounds in 4 months, and done things physically that I honestly didn’t think I could do again in my life.

This place doesn’t sell motivation.
It builds discipline.
It builds consistency.
It builds results.
If you want comfort, stay home or go to Planet Couch.
If you want selfies, buy a ring light.
If you want to actually change your body and your mindset, welcome home.

But if you want results, confidence, and that “damn… that’s really me?” moment in the mirror this is the place.

Nothing but respect for everyone in this building.
Straight up 10/10. Would suffer here again. 😤🔥

And if you ever need help with anything heck it’s my home away from home I’m there 6 days a week ask me and I’ll gladly show you around!

response.snippet: We appreciate you !

7384560215027197602.snippet: Gym is awesome! Wish they had maybe 1-2 more ab equipment such had another decline bench or like a precor weighted leg raise machine like other bodybuilding gyms. But i have amazing hopes that this gym will get better

response.snippet: Thank you we appreciate you and your ideas

7384560215027197602.snippet: Great gym! Equipment is cutting edge, always clean, helpful staff, bathrooms clean. It’s a family vibe, everyone helps each other and treats you with respect. Bravo to Melanie and Paul and their team!

response.snippet: Thank you Stephen!

7384560215027197602.snippet:
I used the 3 day pass before signing up. On the 3rd day, I signed up as I was impressed by how modern and well-maintained everything was. The gym boasts a wide array of brand-new equipment that caters to every workout need, whether you're into cardio, strength training, or functional fitness. The new machines and tools have made a tremendous difference in my workout routine, allowing for more effective and efficient training.

The friendly staff, like Theresa at the front desk creates a welcoming atmosphere, always ready to assist and support members.

The cleanliness, spotless locker rooms and bathroom and how organized the gym are also top-notch, making it a pleasant environment to exercise in.

Overall, I highly recommend Kings and Queens to anyone looking for a top-tier fitness facility with state-of-the-art equipment and a welcoming atmosphere. It has certainly made a positive impact on my fitness journey. Thanks guys! Keep it up.

response.snippet: We appreciate that!

7384560215027197602.snippet: Best gym around! I joined this gym when it first opened as Hollywood. Since changing to Kings And Queens , the gym has only gotten better! There is no other gym around that has the equipment that this gym offers. I’ve been a member of many gyms over the past few decades and could honestly say that I’ve never seen such variety and state of the art equipment! The owner is always adding new pieces that are not found in any other gyms! This gym caters to everyone including new fitness enthusiasts as well as experienced lifters and professional athletes. The trainers are knowledgeable and motivating! I always see the maintenance staff cleaning the floor, locker rooms and equipment. There is also a smoothie bar and healthy meals available to purchase by the front desk. I highly recommend this gym!

response.snippet: Thank You

7384560215027197602.snippet: Wanted a simple 1-day pass to check the gym out, but they demanded $20 just to walk in, even though my family member currently has a membership here! Staff was unprofessional and gave off bad vibes. Not welcoming at all. Didn’t feel like a place that values potential members or good customer service. I do not recommend this place to anybody.

Kings & Queens Gym truly lives up to its name. The atmosphere is welcoming yet motivating, with a clean and well-organized space that makes training enjoyable. The staff is friendly, knowledgeable, and always ready to help with tips or guidance. The equipment is modern and well-maintained, offering everything from free weights to machines for all fitness levels. What sets this gym apart is the community vibe—you feel supported and pushed to be your best. Easily the best gym in the area.

I’ve been going to this gym for a while and it used to be a solid place. The equipment was always clean, the locker rooms were well kept, and the overall atmosphere was great. Lately though, it feels like things have completely changed. The equipment now has missing pieces that the management just doesn’t care to fix. The locker rooms are dirty almost every time I go, and the AC is almost never on. It gets insanely hot in there and people are just dripping with sweat within minutes. They’ve scattered fans around the gym, but it doesn’t help much at all.

What really bothers me is that they clearly can turn on the AC, they just choose not to unless the manager or a pro bodybuilder is around. For $60 to $70 a month, that shouldn’t be the case. Everyone paying to be here deserves a comfortable environment, not just select people. On top of that, they’ve started blasting awful music. It’s frustrating because this gym used to be great, but right now it feels like they’ve completely stopped caring.

response.snippet: Sorry Josh you feel this way but we definitely DO NOT turn the AC on and off for anyone. We had problems getting parts for a few of the units but all has been fixed for a month now and hoping you will understand not only was it out of our control (waiting on parts) but super frustrating for us as well. Great gym with amazing trainers!

2151153265365834403.snippet: It was my first gym back to restart my fitness journey and the unique concept of tethering personal training with membership was something I was intrigued by. Ahmed was also a gentle giant of a trainer, he mixes motivation and knowledge to get you to push just the right amount. I loved it there but had to change due to me having to work more in the city. 2151153265365834403.snippet: I’ve had such a great experience at this gym! The equipment is always clean and well-maintained. Overall, it’s a comfortable, supportive environment that makes it easy to stay consistent with my fitness goals. Highly recommend!”

We appreciate your recommendation and look forward to supporting you in your fitness journey!

2151153265365834403.snippet: This gym is my special place. As a mom, it has been a continuous struggle to maintain a fitness routine that works and finding a gym that offer this level of training ,flexibility , and no brainer choices seemed impossible. Until one morning 9 months ago when I felt so sluggish that I googled “luxury boutique gyms near me” and Energy fitness showed up on top of the list. I called and the rest is history. The whole team is amazing and the facilities are exceptional. The workout equipment is of exceptional quality and there is never a wait for a treadmill or elliptical to be available. I love that as a beginner I don’t feel lost because the classes offered addresses all of my needs and I leave these 45 minute sessions drenched and feeling amazing. I appreciate the Ryde, Strong, Flex model. Shatia and Carolyn have changed my life. Every class that I take provides a different challenge and I love it. Everyone is helpful and kind. Special shoutout to Gingee, Serece, and Marie. They are always so kind and welcoming, and they are always prepared to help. The added bonus of having a relax room to decompress with a sauna session and massage before heading home does so much for my mental health. If you’re on the fence about joining let this be your sign to do it. Don’t walk…RUN to Energy fitness and sign up for a gym home with the most supportive staff and members. This is my happy place.

response.snippet: Thank you for your wonderful review, Sherene! We're thrilled to hear that Energy Fitness has become your special place and that our team has made such a positive impact on your fitness journey. It's great to know that our classes, equipment, and facilities have helped you feel supported and challenged. We appreciate your shoutout to our staff and are delighted that the relaxation options are enhancing your overall well-being. Your encouragement for others to join means a lot to us, and we look forward to continuing to support you in your fitness goals!

2151153265365834403.snippet: Great local gym that is well equipped and clean. The staff is friendly and supportive. My personal trainer Steven keeps me on track with good workouts. Highly recommend!

2151153265365834403.snippet: I love to start my day here. Barbie Korten and KC Putterman are a great challange and boost of energy. Never boring and alwyas interesting routines. Great vibe here at the desk always with Marie and Gingee. Thanks ENERGY RVC for keeping all things up and in motion.

2151153265365834403.snippet: Switched over from orangetheory to this gym in 2023 and I love it! Love having the option to do a class or open gym. Ryde with Coach Tia is absolutely amazing. The sauna and the message chairs are great to have for recovery. When I do the open gym, at any given time I am not waiting for machines and that makes it worth the price.

response.snippet: Thank you for your wonderful review, Debbie! We're thrilled to hear that you've made the switch to our gym and are enjoying the variety of options we offer. We strive to provide a seamless experience for our members, and we're glad to hear you're not having to wait for machines during open gym. Your feedback motivates us to keep delivering the best!

2151153265365834403.snippet: Just getting back to the gym after a decade away and enjoying Energy Fitness! Classes are fun and allow for you to go at your pace which is super helpful when getting back into exercising. Facility is clean and organized. Staff is really kind and helpful - Cerese was so patient in explaining everything and then even followed up to check in on how I was doing. Gingee's class is my favorite way to start the week. 2151153265365834403.snippet: Friendly staff, great trainers, scrupulously clean, great hours, challenging classes, and nice layout. Convenient location with cheap parking and if you don’t mind walking a few blocks, free parking.

2151153265365834403.snippet:
I've been w Energy Fitness since their opening. Beautiful overall, the gym, people are friendly, CLEAN! response.snippet: We appreciate your feedback and are thrilled to hear that you’ve been with us since our opening and enjoy the gym, the friendly atmosphere, and our cleanliness. Your experience is important to us, and we'll take your comments into consideration as we continue to improve. We hope to welcome you both back in the future when it's a better fit!

2151153265365834403.snippet: Everyone is helpful and nice. Not a pretentious gym like some others and I love the fact that personal training is included in the membership. I actually want to come to the gym.

2151153265365834403.snippet: Started going to Energy fitness since October . First gym where I feel comfortable, and seen . Enjoy attending classes, one to one sessions, and all the amenities. Great gym!

2151153265365834403.snippet: This gym is clean, well managed, staff is always courteous & helpful when me members need assistance. Just a pleasure to come here, exercise, relax in the infrared sauna & massage chair - I ♥️this gym.

2151153265365834403.snippet: This is my second review of Energy in RVC and I am still happy to be a part of this gym and its team and community. Great coaches and staff. Thank you all for making me feel welcome and healthy.

2151153265365834403.snippet: I still remember the first evening I walked in crying because I had just had the worst experience at a nearby fitness studio. Daniela sat me down, listened to my experience, consoled me and then explained how the membership works followed by giving me a tour and I took the plunge, signed up that same evening & I can honestly say it was one of the best decisions I’ve ever made! I regularly take RYDE, which is cycling and STRONG, which is like HIIT and if you’re anyone like me who needs guidance, then this is the PERFECT gym for you. response.snippet: Thank you so much for sharing your heartfelt experience with us! 2151153265365834403.snippet: Clean and well appointed gym. Staff is friendly and classes are good ! I love the Ryde classes ! Tia and Barbie are great ! The sauna is clean and relaxing ! Always a great workout and good music too!

2151153265365834403.snippet:
I walked in these doors Spring 2022, & I have never forgot!! The tight knit, & wonderful community at this gym is amazing.

2151153265365834403.snippet: After switching to this gym from my old one due to an injury, I was not only set up and met with a trainer that has been helping guide me through my workouts without pain (shoutout to Carlos!), but I've been enjoying every morning I've been here! 17079054879876610030.snippet: The gym is equipped with all types of cardio equipment, from cardio to strength training. All the equipment is modern and in excellent condition. I especially liked the benches and machines for back and chest training; they are very comfortable and adjustable.

I am new to Crunch and have had a really good experience so far. I just took a cycling class with Teri today and she was an amazing instructor! She was very welcoming to all of the new people in the class and made sure everyone knew how to adjust the seats and footstraps. Definitely take Teri’s class if you get a chance!

I've been coming to this location for a couple of years and Sean and Giovanni at the front desk makes the start of the day start off on a good foot and it makes me comfortable when I practice my dance and MMA. I've been to all locations on long Island and this is definitely my second favorite location just shy of hauppauge. The thing would make it better would be consistent positivity at the front desk. Some days are good and some days are not so good but the rest of the other gym members that I get to speak to make the environment a great atmosphere to be in.

I can’t say enough good things about Shawn and Giovanni—they’re absolute rock stars! Every time I come in, they greet me with a smile and go out of their way to make sure I have a great experience. They’re professional, knowledgeable, and genuinely care about the members. Whether it’s answering questions, keeping the gym spotless, or creating a positive atmosphere, they always go above and beyond. Crunch Fitness is lucky to have them on the team!

I had a disappointing experience with the daycare at Crunch. I brought my daughter in today and was about 15 minutes late I know the window is 9 to 12. The manager accused me of doing this repeatedly, even though this was the first time. The worst part was he threatened to remove my child from the childcare services tied to my membership. I pay for these services, and I didn’t appreciate his threatening tone. He could have simply said, ‘Please be mindful, and if this happens again, we may have to remove the service.’ His approach was not acceptable, and I hope they handle this better moving forward.

I enrolled in a promotional full-access membership that was accepted by the system. However, the terms have not been honored.

My account is currently showing an overdue balance of $113.98, and an additional $39 has already been debited from my bank account. These charges were never clearly explained and do not match what was originally communicated to me.

Multiple attempts to resolve this directly through the club and corporate channels have failed. There is no clear phone support, and emails either bounce back or generate automated responses directing me elsewhere.

At this point, I am requesting a written itemized breakdown of all charges and correction of any improper billing.

Consumers deserve transparent pricing and accessible customer service.

Went in for a tour and it seemed a bit crowded.

Love that they have kids childcare area but that’s additional charge/month.

Wish they have red light therapy and to allow guests to use massage chairs + longer time, as it’s only members and would be a deciding factor for top package.

Victor was very attentive, down to earth, kind and helpful! Good representation for company and really appreciate his time.

The Bellmore location was not as pleasant, seemed very HS clicky during early weekday hours. Both locations had small saunas and people were on their phones inside.

I love Crunch Fitness in East Meadow! The classes are always fun and active and staff is always around to assist if I’m unsure how to use a machine. The real star of the show is Sandi, the absolute best personal trainer I ever worked with. She understood my needs and abilities, would push me to keep going, but also kept a positive attitude and reinforcement. She is the reason I stayed with this gym… Not to mention she’s takes awesome photos of me looking good!

There are only two things you need to know before signing up:
1. The entire parking lot is full of cars and potholes and you will often need to drive around in circles to not be a mile away from the entrance.
2. The gym is full up it's limit with people. It smells like hot breathe when you enter. You will often have to wait minutes for any given machine.

Awful.

response.snippet: Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback Forsaken. We’re sorry to hear about your experience and understand how parking availability and crowd levels can be frustrating. If you’d like to discuss this further, we’d welcome the opportunity to speak with you directly at the club.

17079054879876610030.snippet: Good facility. Wish they were open later on weekends. I pay for the year in cash due to hearing horror stories about over billing.

response.snippet: Thank you for your feedback, Cee! We're glad you like our facility and appreciate your suggestion about weekend hours. If you are having any issues with your billing, please email the General Manager at mjohnson@crunch-li.com

17079054879876610030.snippet: Mary C needs more classes!! She’s so motivational and kind. She cycles and runs a strength Pilates like class! John is the best! He’s a personal trainer and he’s at the front desk sometimes! Always a welcoming smile and a cheerful attitude. Says hi to you in the gym and helps you out! He answered my questions my about the classes offered here! Helped me with a purchase. Great. Attitude, great vibes!! Gotta have more people like him in the gym Fr.

The one star is ONLY due to the HORRENDOUS parking lot overwhelmed by CRATERS!!! How can they have potholes EVERYWHERE and they're huge too! For MONTHS. You go in for a work out and come out to a flat tire. Unacceptable. Go to another crunch, its not worth the suspension, tires or headaches.

Manager "Michael" is extremely unprofessional. Handled a situation with one if his employee's with no class. I would not recommend this gym location due to poor staffing.
The Pros. Sauna, showers, Amazing classes and teachers, clean lots of equipment, diversity!!! location has everything close by….including a huge Parking lot. Owner an staff are helpful!

This gym is great! It’s always super clean and everything is well maintained. What makes it even better is the staff, especially Giovanni and Sean at the front desk. I’ve been consistently impressed by the staff at this gym. From the moment you walk in, you’re greeted with genuine friendliness and professionalism. This afternoon I brought a guardian to sign the waiver but unfairly the general manager didn’t allow me to bring my Other parent and banned me for no reason. 17079054879876610030.snippet:
My husband and I joined this gym right before it officially opened. It was so bright and clean and we loved it. We cancelled for a few months because we went to Lifetime, then LA Fitness and ended up coming back to this Crunch because it’s just solid in terms of equipment and cleanliness.

A very organized gym, never an issue getting a bench or dumbbells. Of course if you come during super busy times you might have to wait a bit but the gym goers are pretty friendly!

Very laid back, and non intimidating and very reasonably priced.

response.snippet: We appreciate the positive feedback Payal. Welcome back to Crunch!!!

5988423024735735610.snippet:
I've been going to this gym since 2013, and over the years, it's become much more than just a place to workout. It's a place of strength, health, and good spirits.
First of all, I'd like to mention the wonderful staff. At reception, you're always greeted with a smile, attention, and a willingness to help. The friendly atmosphere is palpable from the moment you enter, and it's a pleasure to return each time.
The trainers are true professionals. They are attentive, motivating, and always ready to suggest proper technique, support, and help you achieve your best results. Thanks to them, workouts are effective and safe.
The equipment and workout machines deserve special praise. All the machines are modern, comfortable, and well-maintained. They have everything you need—from a cardio zone to strength training equipment—allowing you to workout in a varied and enjoyable way.
I'm very pleased that the gym also has saunas and relaxation areas where you can relax after a workout, recharge, and feel truly comfortable.
But most importantly, the atmosphere exudes a sense of athleticism, support, and respect. People come not only to train, but also to become better, stronger and healthier.

5988423024735735610.snippet:
Impact is a clean and friendly community. I have enjoyed many of the clasess here and have made the Salsa and boxing classes my mainstays. Funny enough, both classes are taught by men named Juan. Juan H. teaches Rumba/Zumba/Salsa- is so energetic and always makes everyone in the class feel at home. It's not just dancing its an experience. He includes everyone and unlike the other Zumba class offered, he makes it about the members which is how it should be

The Personal Trainer and Instructor Juan, is very popular at this gym and has been a cornerstone of the franchise since I began my membership. He teaches Boxing, Mauy Thai, Circuit Training, TRX and Bootcamp. Even with all this, it's still not enough. He is always well prepared and challenges everyone to be their best. He never misses classes, is never late and somehow always makes eveeyone feel like family during the 45 minutes of class time. As a Personal Trainer, he is by far the gym's most sought out coach and well deserved. He is extremely knowledgeable, passionate and just a super sweet gentleman. Oh and not that this matters, but is also super good looking.

There are definitely some aspects of the gym that need improvement, such as one front desk girl who is unpleasant most days, some overcrowding and outdated equipment.

However, overall this is a great place to learn and workout. They are blessed to have both Juan’s and hopefully they can get more equipment to keep up with other gyms in the borough that people seem to be flocking to.

Thank you again for being part of the Impact community. We look forward to seeing you in many more classes ahead!

5988423024735735610.snippet:
This is the best gym in the area. He’s knowledgeable in all areas of exercise and will set you on the right path to achieve your goals the minute you start working with him. He’s a very welcoming and funny person whose energy is contagious. Very happy to be currently working with him.

The facility is very clean, classes are great, never overcrowded, and the sauna works perfectly. I highly recommend giving this gym a try.

Impact Sports Club is a great facility if you're looking to invest in a stronger and more confident you! I started coming here a few months ago because they work with Classpass and I really enjoy fitness classes. After my first month discount ended, I knew I needed to keep coming because the instructors were motivating and the classes were fire. They have everything, from spin to kickboxing to pilates, Barre, yoga, and many more that you can never get bored!

My friends and I were talking about trying out personal training, so I inquired at the front desk and found out that with your membership, your first PT session is free and you can sign up for the next three sessions at a discount. The cost was reasonable so I signed up and I do not regret it. After my intro package, I locked in for more sessions.

I met with coach Carlos who I have been training with for about 10 weeks now and I have gained muscle, am lifting heavier, and have lost a bit of weight too! Carlos is incredibly knowledgeable, patient, and motivating. He makes sure I get the most out of my 30 minutes with him, and that I'm staying on track for the rest of the week with a customized workout plan and nutrition as well.

The results will speak for themselves but the other perks of the gym are the spa/relaxation features. The massage chairs, steam room, and sauna are a nice treat after having pushed yourself to your limits.

Highly professional and amazingly friendly staff. Strongly motivated members. All necessary high-end equipment. Best sauna and steam room. Maintenance is top-notch. Continuously cleaning locker rooms and floors. Great classes and water jet massage tables. Love it.

I can’t say enough great things about my personal trainer Juan. He is knowledgeable, motivating, and genuinely invested in his clients’ success. Every session is thoughtfully planned and tailored to my goals, pushing me just enough while still being supportive and encouraging. His professionalism, energy, and ability to explain exercises clearly have made a huge difference in my consistency and progress. I’ve become stronger, more confident, and more committed to my health because of his guidance. I highly recommend him to anyone looking for a trainer who truly cares and delivers results.

Gina

5988423024735735610.snippet:

Is very clean ,they have amazing steam room and sauna, locker room is super clean and comfortable, also they have tanning room and massage room😍😍it’s my favourite gym ever !!!

This gym needs to revert back to low prices and prioritizing its members from the surrounding community.

response.snippet:
Hi John,

We appreciate you taking the time to share this and we’re truly sorry to hear you feel the gym has changed for the worse. That’s never our intention, especially for members who have been with us and remember what made this place special.

We understand how important it is to feel like your membership is worth it; from equipment and amenities to the overall atmosphere. Your feedback about the locker rooms, sauna, and overall experience is heard. Our team’s goal is always to provide a space where members can train comfortably and confidently, and we will continue working toward improvements.

The events we host are meant to foster community building; bringing new and longtime members together to bond, push each other, and reach goals together. We do this because we genuinely care about everyone’s experience and the culture we’re building. It’s never about choosing events over our members’ workouts, but about strengthening the community that makes this gym what it is.

As we continue to grow, the gym will grow as well. We are working toward expansion and future upgrades, though that won’t take place immediately. We deeply appreciate the surrounding community that helped build us, and at the same time, we hope to inspire people from all areas to come and join our family.

Thank you again for your honesty; feedback like this helps us keep improving.

I had such a great experience training with Coach Juan! He’s incredibly knowledgeable, motivating, and makes each session both challenging and enjoyable. 5988423024735735610.snippet:
This gym is clean, has a nice atmosphere, good equipment, and friendly staff.

Coach Juan is great if you need a personal trainer or boxing coach. Easily the best gym around Rego Park/Forrest Hills. Honest Pros and Cons:

Wonderful gym! The gym is clean, spacious and all workers are nice and helpful there.

I send my daughter with coach Juan Binet for personal training such as boxing and other activities. Coach Juan is funny, professional and dedicated.

My daughter Rachel is blind, coach Juan would close his eyes to experience the feeling of being blind at the beginning and keep doing so. That way he was able to find how to guide my daughter, and he always figure out new ways to lead Rachel for more different exercise. He never limits Rachel and keeps telling her “ Aim Higher”! He always explains to her about the moves and what to expect. He is not only a great coach but a child expert! He is leading Rachel to a higher level of physical well being and impact Rachel “ never settle for less” . Thank you for being an amazing mentor in Rachel’s life. Our family adore and appreciate you coach Juan!

Have been working out here for a few years now…both on my own and with one of their personal trainers (Chris). Staff is exceptionally courtesy, gym is very clean, and love the use of the steam room and hydro beds after a good workout. Highly recommend joining this gym and the classes are great.

Impact sports club is a family gym makes you feel you very comfortable. The employee that I need to acknowledge is Diane (front desk ) . She’s always so helpful and friendly and most importantly her positive vibes. Diane is a great asset to the impact gym family .

5988423024735735610.snippet: Big fan of this gym. Facilities are always clean and well organized. The lighting creates a futuristic and chic environment for a good workout. After a killer workout I truly enjoy using the massage chair and sauna. But my favorite part is the employees they are always helpful and care about what they do.

Such an amazing gym with a vast variety of equipment for all types of exercises. They also have a lot of different classes from yoga, spinning, dancing and much more. Depending on you plan there are many amenities included also. All the staff is very friendly and helpful even the janitor and specially our trainer Steven (I attend with my wife). There are a bunch of gyms around but for me this is set apart from all the rest.

Coach Juan continues to be a remarkable instructor and coach. His decades of experience in both martial arts and boxing, combined with his ability to coach extremely well makes him one of the best in his field. Emphasizing the importance of technique and form, Juan is a natural teacher and it shows in many of the clients who take him on as their coach. He also has great character and a personality to match which makes it easy to work with him. So whether you're just starting out on your fitness journey or you've maintained an active lifestyle, Coach Juan will customize your workouts to ensure you reach your fitness goals.

I’ve been working out at this gym for several months now and I really love it. The facility is always clean, it’s never overcrowded, and the equipment is excellent. The sauna and steam room in the locker room are fantastic perks, and it’s a nice bonus that they provide towels. Overall, it’s one of the best gyms I’ve been a member of.

The only negative, and the reason I didn’t give 5 stars, is one particular staff member who works maintenance during the day — an older, shorter Hispanic gentleman. He has developed a habit of constantly yelling at members in the locker room, especially around the sauna and steam room area. He’ll repeatedly open the sauna door, sometimes three or four times in a short span, loudly telling people what to do and what not to do. It completely breaks the relaxing atmosphere, and it honestly feels unnecessary and overbearing.

At first, I thought maybe it was a language barrier or a cultural misunderstanding, but after experiencing it multiple times, it’s clear this is just his approach. It gives off the impression that he enjoys bossing people around rather than simply doing his job quietly and respectfully. After a workout, members should be able to decompress and relax — not feel like they’re being policed in the locker room.

To be clear: I love this gym, and I plan to keep coming because of all the positives. But this issue has happened often enough that I felt it was important to mention in my review. Hopefully management can address it so the otherwise excellent atmosphere of this gym isn’t spoiled by one employee’s behavior.

7239512342500217346.snippet: Amazing workouts, great coaches and peers. You will not be disappointed. I have lost 15 pounds in the two months that I have been there, one hour in the morning, fast, furious, fun and effective. Come on and give The Sanctuary a try.

You will not experience any toxic gym culture here. When you join CrossFit Sanctuary, you are not joining a gym, you are joining a family focused on fitness. Each class begins with an overview and a hands-on tutorial on proper form for the days workout. Coaches are always on hand to help and guide you. All workouts can be modified to fit your abilities and at the same time the workouts are all fun and challenging. The best part of my day is showing up for a my 6pm CrossFit workout.

CrossFit Sanctuary is a gym that provides a supportive and challenging environment for its members. The coaches, Stephen and Bernie, are the backbone of this gym and their commitment to helping their clients achieve their goals is second to none. They are always available to provide guidance and encouragement, and they consistently go above and beyond to ensure that their clients are making progress. The gym is also home to a friendly and welcoming community of members. Everyone who comes to workout is supportive and encouraging, and it is easy to see that this gym is more than just a place to exercise - it's a community of like-minded individuals who are all striving to become the best versions of themselves.

I'd say Coach Bernie is part coach, part DJ, part saint, and 100% human. Having him stand by you as you go through your WOD not only makes you feel safe but also somehow 20-50% stronger and faster! The first week I took three classes, the second week, four. Then I started asking around to see if every day (save Sunday) would be a good idea because I was so used making myself rest between workouts. Turns out it was one of the best decisions of my life. I'm now an everyday-er and I feel like I've come a long way since I started crossfitting here. I no longer suck at all the things that I used to suck at, i.e. running. For this, and all the awesome, kind and beautiful people at this box, I am so incredibly grateful. And oh yeah, the music is awesome (a great mix of workout hip hop, rock, and deep house)!

Had one session today and I loved every second of it. Such a great workout with great people and a great environment. I LOVE CFS!! I have been a member for over 10 years!! Knowledgeable coaches and a welcoming community atmosphere makes this place so special. The coaches make challenging workouts accessible to all, no matter age, ability or athleticism!

I have not received not or will I receive any compensation for this review. If you have any questions on this review just message me and I'll be more than happy to answer as best as I can.

I found out about CrossFit Sanctuary through Groupon & I was only going to be working out there for a couple of months because I would be moving. I was treated quite nicely as if I was part of their family and welcomed.

Facility and Equipment
-Bathrooms are clean. Equipment and place is well taken care of. The Box is temperature controlled as well for those hot humid summer days. It is also well equipped.

Basecamp/On-Ramp program
Very well done program where there was at least 2 coaches on hand helping you throughout.

CrossFit WODs.
The WODs at CF Sanctuary were SO tough, challenging and fun. They really pushed me cardio and strength wise.
