I can't speak on the Beast Mode class they offer as I wasn't experienced enough to qualify for it. Another bonus is every couple of weeks there is an intense cardio class offered called Bern Baby Bern. Loads of fun and work from what I heard.

Intangibles
-Owners are on hand during the classes in addition to a very well trained and diverse coaching staff.
-CF Sanctuary is very active in the community and works with various charities.
-Members are some of the nicest people I've met. From father and son duos, brothers & sisters, Moms, to the twin sisters working out together. Even the aspiring athletes who compete were all quite nice. No D-bags, ego maniacs or unsavory characters.
-Coaches. Very knowledgeable, they motivate you in good ways, very helpful too with critiques. Always willing to help. No Full Metal Jacket Sgts here.

Helpful Hints. Get there at least 5-10 mins early so you can get close parking. Classes get filled up quickly so register early if possible. The Saturday morning classes fill up the Monday before.

Lastly Stephen and Bernie run a tight ship over at CrossFit Sanctuary. Please check them out and give their classes a try. You really won't regret it. Thanks

As for the cancellation policies - I’ve seen a lot of reviews with negative comments about it. Many yoga studios implement similar policies. I have an insanely busy schedule between kids, work and school - I’ve missed a class and gotten charged because I forgot to cancel in the appropriate time period, and that was my own fault. These policies are in place so that the studio doesn’t lose money and so that it remains fair to others who want to take the classes. The studio makes this policy very clear in their emails, on their website and when you sign up for a class. If you don’t like the policy, don’t sign up. But if you sign up, you agree to the policy. You can’t then get mad and demand it be changed for you.
Anyway - love the classes, great space, can’t wait to attend more!

response.snippet: Thanks Tanya for this review and support! Your explanation is absolutely spot on. We put these policies in place several years ago at the request of our members, who were frustrated they were not getting into classes they wanted to take because people were booking spots in advance and then cancelling at the last minute or not even showing up. The policies are about teaching people to behave in a way that is considerate of others. The fees we collect on late cancellations and no shows are nominal. In an ideal world, they would be $0 because people cancel their bookings in time. See you on the mat!

15827878734560019142.snippet: This review is really 0 stars. I don’t understand how this is a place of peace and harmony yet the most hostile/mean spirited person owns this place. Please don’t book any prenatal yoga sessions with Jennifer Pinna at Living Yoga. If you do, do not purchase a package, because you will lose it without any form of accommodation.

My homegirl bought me a 5-week session as a gift for my pregnancy. She initially booked one class for me. I attended and liked it, even though parking was difficult. After I shared my positive experience, she surprised me with a full month of paid sessions.

Unfortunately, my job had already finalized my schedule a month in advance. I called and emailed Jennifer to let her know I wouldn’t be available on Sundays and asked if she had any other available days or weekdays I could make up the sessions. She said no.

I explained my situation, and her response was that my friend should’ve known my schedule before booking with her. I told her it was a gift and that I didn’t even know I’d be scheduled to work Sundays in June. Later, when my supervisor said I could switch to working Saturdays starting in July, I asked Jennifer if I could move the sessions to next month. She said no again.

She didn’t try to work with me at all or offer any flexibility. I ended up losing 5 fully paid sessions. That’s terrible customer service. I would never recommend anyone to Living Yoga. They don’t answer the phone, respond late to messages, offer no accommodations, and make zero effort to reschedule or communicate.

They really just take your money and run. I’m very disappointed—but God is good

response.snippet: Hi Marie. Our prenatal yoga program is not part of our regular class schedule. It is only offered as limited series at certain times of the year and space is very limited. Because of this, we are unable to offer make up sessions, alternate dates, or refunds for missed sessions. We make this very clear at the time of sign up and in each confirmation email we sent to you. You didn't approach us about your issues until after the series had already started. It's unfortunate that your friend didn't check with you first about your availability, given that the conditions of our program didn't change between the first class you took and the subsequent series you were enrolled in.

15827878734560019142.snippet:

I tried to text them about missing the class. The moment I got off the train, i called the front desk and explained the situation, she said sorry and instead of charging for $20, she will charge me $10. I was furious on how they run the business on trying to make profit out of cancellation fee for events that are out of my control. She asked me to talk to the owner, i didn’t want to waste my time to repeat the same thing, that’s not much to say more as I sent the service alert on MTA app to them. I should have bought just a single class instead of new members trial. That’s my advice to anyone who wants to check out the studio. Don’t commit to a monthly package until you try it out. Another inconvenient fact is the bathroom is outside of the studio shared with other suites on the same floor. The condition of the bathroom is comparable to those at train station. The hoops they made you jumped through to waive cancellation fee even for the first time is ridiculous as you can see from other reviewers. Not going back.

response.snippet: Hi Diane: Thank you so much for your kind words! I am so glad that you are enjoying your classes at Moonflower Yoga, either through Zoom or in person. It is so nice to have you joining us. For the in-person classes at the studio, it is important to me to have the new standards in place to keep people safe while attending a great yoga or meditation class. And I love greeting people!

4170210566196261021.snippet: When the pandemic started, I was looking for an online yoga studio. My daughter was highly recommended Moonflower Yoga Studio in Bellmore, where she was taking yoga classes. I began taking chair yoga classes via Zoom and have continued with the "hybrid" classes. One of the best choices I have made. The classes are wonderful, I feel much better, and the owner Nancy is professional and caring at the same time. Also I have made new friends as well. I live in Florida and hope to one day be able to visit NY and meet my new friends in person at Moonflower Yoga.

response.snippet: Hi Barbara: I, too, am so glad that your daughter recommended Moonflower Yoga to you! One of the great things about the Zoom classes is the ability to have people joining us for classes who live out of state. It is so nice to have you attend classes from Florida. I am happy that you have made new friends and the classes help you feel better. And I also look forward to the date when we can meet in person!

4170210566196261021.snippet: Moonflower has been such an integral part of my life! Thank goodness for the wonderful zoom classes offered during the pandemic! The owner of the studio has taken every precaution to keep all of the “in person” classes safe by installing air filtration and maintaining an immaculately clean studio. Making sure that all students who enter the studio are comfortable to practice safely is Moonflower’s top priority and I am so grateful to them for providing a beautiful and safe environment to practice yoga. Thank you!

response.snippet: Hi Terry: Thank you for your feedback! The Zoom classes have been a lifeline to many of the attendees and me who were feeling lonely and sad as a result of the COVID outbreak. They are a great way to take care of yourself, have some fun, build strength, stretch tight muscles, and have an enjoyable time chatting with people in the Zoom rooms - all from the safety of your home. With the return of a few, in-person classes, it was important to me to have safety protocols in place, so that those entering the studio could feel safe while enjoying their in-person experience.

4170210566196261021.snippet: Moonflower yoga has changed my life! I am a cancer patient presently in remission that has found a number of yoga classes at this studio to help me get through the toughest times. The owner, Nancy has continuously gone out of her way to accommodate those who either choose to use Zoom or if vaccinated go to the studio. A personal approach is always given and there are never more than 5 or 6 people in a class She continues to goes over & above to adhere to the guidelines required. If you are chosen to take part in the studio, temperature checks, social distancing and vaccinations are her requirements in order for all to stay safe. Moonflower yoga is like a second family to me. The owner and instructors continue to go out of there way to make this difficult time as easy as possible. There are also many different classes to choose from. I would highly recommend this yoga studio to anyone looking for a small and personal approach when doing yoga.

response.snippet: Hi Lori: Thank you so much for your kind words. I know you’ve been through some challenging times, and I’m so glad that your health is better and that the classes at Moonflower Yoga helped you through that period. It’s important to me to keep the studio a safe place for people to come when attending an in-person class, and I love seeing those smiling faces walk through the front door. You are also an important part of the studio, and we look forward to having you join us for classes either in person or remotely.

4170210566196261021.snippet:
I searched high and low for a studio like Moonflower before beginning my practice! The personal attention and care given by the owner, Nancy, and her teachers is a rarity! The small class size assures you will be gently guided to the correct positions and adaptations. This is critical for safety and growth in one's practice.
The warmth and support of the people that practice at Moonflower has been an unexpected gift! So many special people find their way to Moonflower's door- and once exposed to everything that makes it unique-they can't help but stay! The workshops and social events offered give us all another way to grow and find the light. What a joy to be surrounded by so many wonderful women on the journey!
Thank you, Moonflower, for being SO much more than just a place to take yoga !

response.snippet: Many thanks Dian! It is very important for me that people receive personal attention, so they can have a great practice. And I love the fun workshops and events, and I’m glad that you do too!

4170210566196261021.snippet: Nancy provides classes for all levels with kindness and support. The studio is clean and welcoming. The classes provide a way seniors can keep active. The owners support for charities and nurses is highly commendable. There are also additional workshops like cooking and mediation which are amazing. I highly recommend it.

response.snippet: Karen: Thank you for your feedback! And THANK YOU and the other nurses who have done so much to help the community during the COVID outbreak, as well as other times. The nurses have been pillars of strength during a challenging time. I’m glad you that you enjoy your classes, and they help you to keep active, as well as relax. I, too, love the workshops as they provide an opportunity to learn something new and have fun.

4170210566196261021.snippet: What owner and proprietor Nancy has created at Moonflower Yoga is a challenging feat. I've been practicing and teaching yoga for most of my adult life, all over the world -- and it is rare to keep a yoga shala alive and breathing in the way Nancy has. A studio which offers the beautiful and authentic experience of YOGA and MEDITATION in all it's wondrous forms and off-shoots, combined with business expertise, heartfelt customer service, and impeccable cleanliness, state of the art technology, all making for an unsurpassed commitment to a yoga family of practitioners who call it home, even through a pandemic. As such, Moonflower Yoga, is a sacred space, a community place, where everyone is invited to meet on the mat in love and peace and equality - whether for an asana workshop, a vegan cooking class, chair yoga for seniors, gentle restorative at the end of the day or a Saturday morning sweat. We are so fortunate here in our local community to have Moonflower Yoga and I, for one, am grateful every time I step in the front door. 💟. 🕉

response.snippet: Thank you, Lynn, for your kind words. It is important to me to create a sacred space where people can enjoy a journey of discovery, as well as a community place where we can relax, have fun, and learn something new. I am very blessed to be joined by a great, dedicated group of teachers who help the students improve their practice and learn ways to de-stress and feel better, whether they attend a class online or walk through the door. I am very grateful for your support of Moonflower Yoga. Thank you!

4170210566196261021.snippet:
I found Moonlower a few yeas ago when I was recovering from knee replacement surgery. I started with a chair yoga class taught by Nancy Weskoff who is the owner of the studio. Nancy is a generous and accessible teacher who soon became a friend. Moonflower has given me my life back in a most encouraging and warm and safe place.
With Covid we all did zoon classes, and once the vaccine was available we could come to the studio again. Small classes in the serene atmosphere first require that you are vaccinated to protect all who come there. We even start with a temperature check and hand sanitation :). The studio is serene, safe and loving. I am 78 years old and could not bee more grateful for spiritual and physical healing I received, and especially for Nancy.

response.snippet: Rose: Thank you for your beautiful review. I am happy that you discovered the studio several years ago and that the classes have been helpful to you. It has been inspiring to see the progress that you have made and the strength and flexibility that you have gained from attending the classes on a consistent basis. I always enjoy seeing your loving smile walk through the front door of the studio.

4170210566196261021.snippet: I cannot say enough how amazing my private birthday yoga class was! Nancy helped me out so much when some of my friends were not able to sign up for one class. Rose was so knowledgeable and lead a class that was so relaxing! I recommend this studio to all!

response.snippet: Danielle: It was a pleasure meeting you and your friends, and I’m very happy that you enjoyed your birthday celebration at Moonflower Yoga! Rose and I wish you a wonderful year ahead filled with many blessings.

4170210566196261021.snippet: I've been going to Moonflower Yoga since November, and I'm really happy I found this place. It's a very positive environment, and Nancy is a great teacher. There are a variety of classes for all skill levels. Lots of personal attention. Definitely check this place out!

response.snippet: Stephanie: Thank you, and I'm so glad you are enjoying your classes at Moonflower Yoga!

4170210566196261021.snippet: I have been going to Moonflower Yoga for nearly three years and it has literally changed my life. I knew from the moment I first walked through the doors that Moonflower Yoga was a special place. It is a community where one can learn and practice yoga with some terrific instructors, learn about meditation and other yoga related topics, join a book club, play Mah Jongg, join knitters and crocheters and make new friends. Moonflower Yoga is just a wonderful place to enrich your life. .

response.snippet: Thank you Marjorie! I'm so glad that you found Moonflower Yoga, and it is a pleasure to have you at the studio for the yoga classes, as well as the Club events.

4170210566196261021.snippet: I have been going to Moonflower Yoga since last October and since then, I have seen a tremendous improvement in not only with my back pain, but with my overall flexibility and strength. The classes are small enough that you truly get that one-on-one trainer feeling. The instructors actually go around and help every student get into the correct poses, whereas in some of the larger classes, you kind of feel lost trying to keep up. Also, this place offers the best workshops. I had the honor of meeting Chandresh Bhardwaj in one of his meditation workshops and I learned so much from him that it really has improved my daily life. I have to say, my top favorite teachers are Nancy and Melinda. You can never go wrong with one of their classes. My only regret has been not finding this place earlier.

response.snippet: Thank you, Myra, for your review! You should be proud of how much you have grown & how flexible you have become since coming to the studio. What seemed like an impossibility months ago is now a reality as you are stretching in ways you didn't think was possible. I look forward to helping you on your continued yoga journey.

4170210566196261021.snippet: I highly recommend Moonflower Yoga. I have been going to classes both in person and on zoom for about three years now. The staff is very professional, kind and accommodating. There is a wide range of classes for everyone. If you want to feel relaxed and calm, go to Moonflower Yoga.

response.snippet: Thank you Michele! I am glad that you found Moonflower Yoga and that the classes help you to feel relaxed and calm. It is always nice to have you joining us.

4170210566196261021.snippet: I have been taking classes here for the last 4 years and it has been an absolute lifesaver. I am much stronger, more flexible, and more at ease thanks to Nancy and her wonderful studio. She's created a wonderful community with something for everyone. The classes are great and varied and there are wonderful workshops on lots of different subjects. There's a knitting club and a book club, too!

response.snippet: Jessica: Thank you for your kind words! I am very happy that you discovered Moonflower Yoga, and we so enjoy having you at the studio each week. It has been such a joy to watch your yoga practice deepen as you become stronger and more flexible.

4170210566196261021.snippet: The best yoga experience especially for someone just starting out and looking for a great way to help bring balance into their lives. I highly recommend this studio. The instructors are great and the classes are offered at times that easily fit many busy work/home schedules.

response.snippet: Hi Ann: Thank you for your review! It is always important to me to work with those who are new to yoga and help them discover the many ways that yoga can help you feel better physically as well as mentally. Life is busy for many of us, so having a wide variety of class times is also important so that people can find 30 minutes or 60 minutes to take care of themselves and feel better. I'm so glad that you discovered Moonflower Yoga and are enjoying your classes. It is always great to have you attending classes at the studio.

4170210566196261021.snippet: Moonflower is the cleanest, most caring and professional studio I've been to. The intimate class setting is second to none. I've taken classes here, as well as workshops and I have never been disappointed!

response.snippet: Thank you so much for your kind words! I am so glad that you enjoy the small-class setting, as well as the workshops. It’s important to me to always show kindness to those who attend classes, as well as offer a clean, safe place in which students and teachers can enjoy coming together to practice.

4170210566196261021.snippet: Moonflower Yoga has an amazing variety of classes, awesome workshops & such a tranquil atmosphere. Thank you Nancy, Moonflower is my happy place!

response.snippet: Donna: Thank you, and I'm so glad that Moonflower Yoga provides you a happy place! We love having you at the studio.

15060254663127387547.snippet: It’s hard to find places that still have hot 26+2 after the pandemic. I am a huge fan of this place. Always hot, always a good class.

I've been coming to this studio for a decade and I have nothing but amazing things to say about the studio and the instructors. The hot room may require some adjusting but once you find your pace and practice style it becomes a space that calls you back in time and time again. This space will be kind to you when you haven't been kind to yourself, it will revitalize you when you're stripped down to nothing and it will lift you when you feel like you're drowning. It's clean, the schedule has plenty of classes throughout the day, and you don't have to know a single thing about yoga. It's accommodating to the newest of practitioners who don't even own a yoga mat and to those who have years of experience under their belts. A very warm thank you to Tomoko, the owner, for keeping this space beautiful and inviting, always. She's a true gem to this community. If you're reading this, come by and visit this lovely place and see for yourself!

Before I stepped into this studio, the idea of hot yoga was a bit intimidating to me. Finally, I took my first class a couple of weeks ago, and I think I'm pretty much hooked. The instructors and staff are warm and encouraging, and even though I consider myself a beginner, I felt that my presence there was no less significant than other attendees who have been practicing for years.
A great studio with a comfortable atmosphere, and friendly staff. If you're in the area and share the same curiosity about hot yoga that I did, push past your worries and give this place a shot.

I enjoy the HotYoga4You and the 60 minutes yoga practice. The studio offers a welcoming and friendly environment without any expectations about the practice and/or pressure to be part of the family. One just comes to be the best that one can be that day. The instruction is high quality yet there are instructors that I like better. The studio is small and could use another shower but one can manage. Still, the yoga room is the best that I have tried in the city. About me, I am a middle aged disabled veteran who needs to heal in all levels. This place has been part of the solution. I am not a regular but I always come back because I love the mental and physical flexibility and ease at the end of each practice. In short, if you are looking for a challenging but doable physical exercise program to strengthen your soul, mind, heart and body, join us. This is the right place with the right people. You won't regret it.

I have had nothing but great experiences at this yoga studio. Everyone is awesome from the teachers, staff, and different students. Even though I am not a regular in class I know that when I finally do return I will be greeted by the smiling faces of all that work here. The teachers and great and motivating on days when I need the extra encouragement. I only hope to start fitting a few classes a week back into my schedule because I honestly miss the clam it brings to my life when I am practicing a few times a week and the way it helps tone and dextox my body.

Love practicing hot yoga at Hot Yoga for You!! The instructors are so good, giving feedback on postures to help you achieve your best. Every class helps me get more flexible and feel great in my body. What a blessing to have this place so close to home. I would move next door, if I could. ❤️

I love everything about this hot yoga class. I've tried different gym and exercise, even the power plate. I finally found what's really works for me and had changed me psychically and mentally from this hot yoga.
I started 2012 Jan. It was my New Year resolution to get healthy and get back in shape. It was my smartest decision I ever made aside from marrying my husband.
I truly see the result after a month, I gain more energy. After 8 months, I see my waistline again and less stress. When I stopped going for few months, I noticed my body quickly went back with belly fats and low energy and even got moody.
Now, hot yoga is part of my lifestyle and it balance me from being a mom of 2 kids and working full time in the high level of stress -fashion industry and a part time job. I love the 60 minutes vs. 90 minutes class. The 60 minute class is spontaneous and focus, I get the same results and fit my crazy schedule much better. Your Health is Your Wealth.

Thank you to all my hot yoga instructors.

I have no point of reference, since this is the only yoga studio I've ever practiced at, but this place is fantastic. I always feel well-treated here; instructors make an effort to know the students, classes are usually no more than 35 students or so, and the folks who work here are very friendly.

The instructors are all competent, but I suppose everyone will have teachers they prefer. Tomoko, the manager of the studio, is terrific. Very helpful (when I had an issue with my account, she quickly rectified the situation) and probably my favorite instructor, though really everyone here is very good.

The changing space is pretty small --- one communal area for folks to unpack, and about 4 dressing rooms to change clothes. Not really a big deal; just something to be prepared for.

The 60 minute classes are NOT "easier" than the 90 minute classes, at least just beacuse they're shorter. You'll be moving a lot more during the 60-min, and it almost feels like a different workout altogether. I enjoy mixing it up a bit.

Definitely worth checking out if you're into Hot Yoga and in the neighborhood.

response.snippet: Wow, Arthur, your compliments and feedback are so motivating! It's music to my ears that you always feel welcome here, and can get a great workout in with us. -Tomoko

15060254663127387547.snippet: I never thought I would try hot yoga but I took a chance, went, and loved it! The staff made me feel welcome right away. There is a great first-time client deal ($25 for 15 unlimited days), a wide variety of hot yoga class options, and instructors that are thoughtful and dedicated.

response.snippet: It's wonderful that you enjoyed your first class, Jessica! We're delighted to have you with us for the next few weeks and hope we can continue a wonderful practice beyond that. Anytime you need assistance or have a question, I'm always here to help. -Tomoko

15060254663127387547.snippet: I've been practicing here for a little over 4 years now and I have grown to love the yoga, the instructors, and the friendly atmosphere. After several knee surgeries, I thought my days of being physically active were over until I found this hot yoga studio. With time and patience, I've been able to make huge strides and make my body create postures I never thought my knees would allow! A recent added bonus: after being on cholesterol meds since my 20s, I no longer need to take anything!

This is a fantastic studio with a charming staff. It is well kept and a pleasure to practice in. Hot yoga is extremely physically and mentally demanding, so be prepared to work hard and sweat. When it's all said and done, you will feel great but don't forget to smile when you're in it, it really does help!
Great traditional 26+2 studio with some other hot yoga offerings, also(Vinyasa, Yin and Lu Jong). Staff and practitioners are friendly and knowledgeable.

I cannot say enough about how much I love and appreciate HotYoga4You. When my fiance and I discovered this wonderful place we were looking to enhance our lives with yoga. We did not know what to expect. We did not know anything about most forms of yoga and even less about hot yoga. We dove in. I am so happy we did. I am so happy to be a member of this facility.

HotYoga4You gives me the best workout. It never ceases to be challenging. As I improve in each posture I only challenge myself more. I don't think it will ever become easy and this is one of the things I love most about this yoga. I get an aerobic exercise as well as strength training.

But the best part of this possibly is the meditation that I receive in my practice. I leave classes with such a sense of peace and tranquility and ever grateful for that as well.

I am looking forward to taking on my first 30-day challenge soon!

Been doing hot yoga for a year or so now. The teachers here are very competent & compassionate. The studio is clean & cheery. The yoga in the hot room is very demanding. It satisfies me physically, mentally & emotionally. During the classes I feel very challenged, but afterwards I feel... well satisfied. It's for all levels; beginners on up. I would recommend Rego Park to anyone, and have. Give it more than a try & you'll get a lot out of it.

Love this studio! Very clean, all the instructors are helpful, personable, and knowledgeable. Everyone is there to help themselves feel better and its so refreshing to be in a fitness/wellness environment that is not superficial or filled with people constantly posting on social media while working out.

I do wish that some people would have a little kindness for their fellow classmates. If you have a heavy cough or cold maybe stay home until your a little better. If you must come in then wear a mask or at least cover your mouth and nose when sneezing and/or coughing. We are all in a hot room together- wide, hard sneezes and coughs all throughout the class is gross and inconsiderate.

Its been 4 years since I first came to this studio, and although each day is different, I am always amazed how it helps me in mind and body. And I was a mess when I first came, both weight wise and otherwise. The yoga eliminated my chronic asthma, helped me lose a lot of weight (30+lbs) and healed my knee, lower back and and some pulled muscles in my abdomen. However, the best benefits to me, by far, are the mental benefits. I am a far calmer person, and I think am easier to be around than before. As far as the studio itself, it is kept very clean, and the instructors are top-notch, helpful, knowledgeable and extremely patient. My fellow students also are a big reason to practice yoga here, they are among the warmest, kindest group of people I know. Overall, HotYoga4You has been a positive force for good in my life, and I frequently recommend it to my family and friends because I want them to experience the same feelings of well being, health and center-ness that practicing hot yoga here has given me.

I love attending classes at HotYoga4You at Rego Park. I have practiced at other studios before, and the instructors here are the best. They keep you motivated and they all have a great positive energy while teaching class. I have definitely improved in my yoga practice because of their support.

I'm a new Bikram Yoga Student...

I started practicing at this studio in the Spring and the staff/owners/volunteers are helpful, friendly and supportive. The studio is kept very clean and is airy. It never stinks or smells stale.

I do dislike the somtimes overcrowded (I like my space) classes, and that there is only one shower... but the proximity of the venue to my home as well as everyone's positive energy helps to make up for it's shortcomings.

Contrary to many yoga attendees- I had no real physical injuries or ailments to address at Hot Yoga. My only issue was a lack of flexibility. As an avid runner/cyclist, my hamstrings and lower back had very little flexibility (a prescription for possible injury). My wife had lower back issues and was attending Hot Yoga for therapeutic purposes. She asked if I'd like to join her at Hot Yoga- I hesitantly agreed. The first week was very difficult- between getting use to the poses, the heat, the sweating- I thought it wasn't for me. After the second week, I was pleasantly surprised I could easily bend down and effortlessly touch my toes! That was it! After 2 years of Hot Yoga, I can't help but smile when I easily perform simple everyday tasks like balancing on one foot to put my socks and shoes on or performing the awkward pose to get stuff from a lower shelf. As a more senior attendee (age-wise not years practicing) I can say this routine has turned back the cruel hands of time.
Between the friendly, no pressure instructors and the comradery of fellow yoga students, attending Hot Yoga classes is a welcome addition to my wellness routines!

I've been practicing Hot Yoga for many years on and off, and can truly say that when I'm consistently going to class, I'm a healthier and happier person. And I believe that the reason I have been practicing so frequently within the past year is because I found the awesome Hot Yoga of Rego Park studio. The location is great (close to public transit and driving distance from the city and western Long Island), the fellow yogis are friendly, and the teachers are some of the best I've ever had the pleasure of working with. I just recently moved to a new area in Queens where there are other Hot Yoga studios closer to my apartment, but I'd rather travel a bit further to come to HotYoga4You in Rego Park!! Happy 5 year anniversary to the studio, and wishing it many, many more to come.

8874758709252024993.snippet: Loved my class with Marcelina! It was a great workout, and calming too. I left refreshed and happy. Highly recommend!

A call to practice. Know Yoga Know Bliss is a devoted community of teachers and students. I've taken classes with almost all of their teachers at this point, and I've never been disappointed (or injured). Classes are taught with an emphasis of exploration, rather than conformity. In other words, you do what you choose to do, what feels good to you. I love the vibe, the clean aesthetic, and the devotion to build an inclusive yoga community of all levels of practice. Great sound system, perfect environment, privacy, and comfort. Enjoy and Namaste.

This studio has literally become my new home away from home. Marc and all is amazing instructors guide you on the most beautiful journey and there is always a class available for every level. I'm so grateful to have found this studio and I highly recommend it to new yogis as well as seasoned yogis. Thank you to the entire Know Yoga Know Bliss Family. You are all remarkable!

Mark the owner, and all the staff at Know Yoga Bliss are excellent, professional, and kind yoga teachers. Each gently corrects your posture and encourages you to challenge yourself at your own pace. Classes are held in a cozy, clean space with enjoyable music in the background. Highly recommend.

I was always somewhat intimidated by the whole Yoga thing, however Marc and his team of instructors make it very easy for beginners to settle right in and feel at ease. The top notch music playlists make for a unique experience, along with their spiritual guidance. The studio is well located, clean and has just the right size classes.

My yoga practice as both a student and teacher has taken me to many different studios and gyms in New York, LA and Florida.
The studio owner is meticulous about cleanliness and all the teachers are very warm and inviting. Whether you are a beginner or advanced student you walk out feeling great.

Had an exceptional experience at Know Yoga Know Bliss. They have impressive instructors and ownership. It’s a yoga sanctuary that radiates light, positivity and openness. I highly recommend this studio to anyone at any level of yoga. Namaste!
A fantastic studio with great teachers, wonderful atmosphere, and a caring community. It is open to any level, I came as a beginner and felt most welcome. Highly recommend it!

Clean. Kind Instructors. Awesome tunes.

I Have taken classes that range from introductory and fun to classes that are advanced and had leaving with that post workout glow.

A great community.
Marc is the best instructor. Studio was very clean and this was the best yoga class I have ever attended.

response.snippet: We welcome new Yogis like Sam with open arms. Those who are apprehensive about Yoga usually are the ones who need it the most. Namaste

8874758709252024993.snippet: Very clean and inviting studio. Wonderful classes and instructors. Music is always a great touch.
Really enjoyed the class. It was my first time. Instructor was great
It is an aesthetically pleasing space, clean and with a great vibe and great teachers.
Very clean studio , nice instructor , best in the manhasset area

Gem in Manhasset
Beautiful Modern Studio
Great instructors
Thank you
Great teachers and great classes for all experience levels

743357547452262680.snippet:
I went today for my first ever reformer Pilates class and unfortunately had a really disappointing experience. I told the instructor (Sasha) that it was my first time working out in a long time, and instead of feeling guided or welcomed, I felt like I was a burden. She was dismissive, unfriendly, and made me feel uncomfortable throughout the class.

At one point I actually got up and left because I felt embarrassed and singled out in front of everyone. I wasn’t shown how to use the machine properly, just told what to do, and as a first-timer that made the whole experience really overwhelming.

I chose this studio because it’s close to home and has great reviews, and I was hoping to start a weekly routine here — but after today, I won’t be coming back. I later saw another review from someone who had almost the exact same experience with the same instructor, so I don’t think this is just a one-off situation.

I really believe instructors should be welcoming and patient, especially with beginners. Today just wasn’t that, and it really discouraged me instead of motivating me. I hope this feedback helps improve the experience for future newcomers.

response.snippet: Hello J- We appreciate you trying out our studio and review and we're sorry that you had an overall less than great experience. We have discussed your review with our staff. Each teacher has their own unique personality and even one did not work for you, there are lots of teacher and classes to try and someone else might work just right.

743357547452262680.snippet:
Tried out pilates for the first time with Sasha and had a wonderful experience. She was very accommodating and kind, carefully working with me and the class, guiding us step by step. I could not have asked for a better experience, and I look forward to scheduling more classes with Sasha in the future, and continuing my pilates journey!

Great studio!

Unfortunately did not have a good experience with Sasha's classes. This instructor lasers in on clients who struggle with movements, often calling them out in ways that feel embarrassing rather than supportive. Her verbal corrections are often very confusing without clear explanation and has frequently held up the class. I've frequently had physical adjustments from Sasha that felt abrupt and aggressive. I've had my hair pulled and pushed into positions which made me uncomfortable. I've also observed clients getting hurt in class and walk out which seemed related to lack of clear instruction and proper remediation of movements. Overall Sasha's teaching style does not feel safe or encouraging. I would not recommend.

response.snippet:
Hello I just wanted you to know we have discussed your review with our staff and we take your concerns seriously.
We also hope the reviewer realizes that there is a staff of over fifteen different teachers here, they all have different and unique personalities and if one doesn't work for you, there are lots of different classes for you to try.
The other point I would like to make it while I don't mean to discount your experience- that's not the experience for everyone. Sasha is a busy and respected teacher here. She teaches fitness and rehab to lots of older adults to teens and she is very liked by different people. Of course we all aim to do better, and hope you can find a way to try out the great diversity of fitness classes that this studio offers.

743357547452262680.snippet: Ok so Ive taken an introductory class with Elizabeth before and she was great!! Then taken some morning classes with Spencer and he was also very nice! My friends and I had booked a 9am class with Sasha recently as that was one of the only time spots we could take a class after we dropped off our kids to school! It was my friends first time doing a reformer pilates class and as Ive had a positive experience with the other instructors before - I assured them it was going to be great! Ive heard positive things about this instructor but Sasha was definitely NOT friendly to those newer to Pilates! There was another guest there too that was a total pilates snow and kept making comments about how we shouldn't be taking this class! The instructor didn't go over any of the machine parts and corrected us super roughly (ex: squeezed my face and foot..)and responded many times by insinuating we didn't know what we were doing! Spencers never mentioned this was a more advance class or what was a more beginning level class! Maybe you guys need to start adding that in your class descriptions so people can sign up more accurately!! Honestly this instructor left such a poor taste in my mouth that I definitely wont be recommending this studio to any more friends! Gentle yet effective, regaining control of your body.

I originally came to relieve my lower back pain, but after just a few classes, not only was the pain significantly reduced, but my posture also improved. Pilates doesn't leave you exhausted like high-intensity exercise, yet each movement precisely targets the muscles you need. Instructor Amy is very attentive and encouraging; the atmosphere is warm and loving, perfect for someone like me who doesn't usually exercise. I recommend it to anyone looking to improve their health, shape their body, and relax!

469715191609364043.snippet:
感受到身体的改变，每一次都值得！
自从开始上普拉提课后，我的身体有了明显的变化。不但核心力量增强了，肩颈的紧张感也减轻了很多。Amy 老师非常专业，动作讲解清晰，也很注重个别学员的身体状况，常常会根据我的身体情况做调整。环境干净、安静，让人特别放松。每次上完课都觉得整个人轻松了不少，已经离不开这个课程了！
469715191609364043.translatedSnippet:
Feeling the changes in my body makes every class worthwhile!

Since starting Pilates classes, I've noticed significant changes in my body. Not only has my core strength improved, but the tension in my shoulders and neck has also decreased considerably. Teacher Amy is very professional, explaining the movements clearly and paying close attention to each student's individual needs, often adjusting the classes according to my situation. The environment is clean, quiet, and incredibly relaxing. After each class, I feel so much lighter and more refreshed; I can't live without this course!

469715191609364043.snippet: 我非常推荐这家普拉提工作室！环境干净舒适，Amy老师非常专业又有耐心，每节课都感觉被细心照顾到。上课后我的身体变得更有力量、柔韧性也提高了不少。特别喜欢小班教学的氛围，既有针对性又很放松。如果你想改善体态、减压或增强核心力量，这里真的值得一试！
469715191609364043.translatedSnippet: I highly recommend this Pilates studio! The environment is clean and comfortable, and Amy, the instructor, is incredibly professional and patient; I felt meticulously cared for in every class. 469715191609364043.snippet: 第一次接触普拉提就爱上了！课程非常专业，动作细致讲解到位，教练也特别耐心，帮助我调整身体姿势，让我真正感受到核心发力。上完一节课整个人都轻松了，腰背舒服多了，连睡眠也变好了。非常推荐给想要改善体态和增强身体力量的朋友！

After one class, I felt so much lighter, my lower back felt much better, and even my sleep improved. I highly recommend it to anyone looking to improve their posture and increase their strength!

469715191609364043.snippet: Amy老师的课程内容科学系统，教练具备扎实的专业知识和丰富的经验。动作讲解细致，能根据不同身体状况进行调整，安全又高效。几节课下来，明显感觉核心更有力量了，长期肩颈紧张也缓解了不少。是非常值得长期坚持的锻炼方式。

After just a few classes, I can clearly feel that my core is stronger, and my long-term neck and shoulder tension has been significantly relieved. It's a highly recommended exercise method for long-term commitment.

469715191609364043.snippet: 我真的很喜欢这个普拉提工作室，每次上完课都觉得身心放松很多。教练超级专业，对动作的细节都讲的很详细，也会根据每个人的身体状况做出调整，不会强迫你做超出能力的动作，但又能鼓励你慢慢进步。最喜欢的是她人真的很好，很有耐心，哪怕动作做不标准也会温柔指导，从来不会让人有压力。刚开始我完全是新手，但在她的带领下慢慢找到了身体的感觉，也更了解自己的身体了。尤其是在核心力量、身体稳定性和体态改善方面，我明显感觉到自己的变化。
469715191609364043.translatedSnippet: I really love this Pilates studio. Every class leaves me feeling so relaxed, both physically and mentally. I started as a complete beginner, but under her guidance, I gradually found my footing and gained a better understanding of my body. 17562216292585440040.name: Jihra Gavilanes
17562216292585440040.text: I have extensive CF experience. Tried joining but they asked me to schedule a consultation. The “owner” tried to get me to sign up to some $500 30 day kick start that includes all kinds of things that I don’t need or want. I was simply looking to join their CrossFit group classes as I into the neighborhood and needed a new CrossFit gym. They do have online $209 membership but insisted I needed to buy their $500 membership first. Crazy
17562216292585440040.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Jihra,

Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. 

At CrossFit Sunnyside, every new member—whether a beginner or someone with years of CrossFit experience—starts with a complimentary consultation so we can learn about their goals, fitness background, and any limitations before jumping into group training. The free consultation is also an opportunity for you to learn about our program, how it is structured, and how it might be different from other gyms.

Our onboarding process for all new members includes personal training sessions to assess individual strengths and areas for growth. This ensures each athlete’s training is safe, personalized, and appropriately challenging. The cost of these sessions is built into our introductory membership plans, such as our 30-Day QuickStart or 90-Day Kickstart, which help each athlete build a foundation for success.

We never want anyone to feel pressured—our goal is to make sure every person who joins us fully understands what we offer and that it’s a great fit for both sides. The $209 membership you referenced becomes available after completing the intro phase, once athletes have been safely integrated into our program.

We wish you the best in finding a gym that aligns with your needs, and we appreciate the opportunity to clarify our process for others considering joining our community.

— The CrossFit Sunnyside Team

1334589656660225776.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Jasvir, 

Thank you for your 4 years of dedication to CrossFit OZP. We truly value the time you spent as a member of our community, and it is saddening to hear that external insecurities have impacted your perspective on your journey with us. 

Regarding your concerns about social media, we want to clarify that we have fully complied with your initial requests. Although you signed a media waiver upon joining that granted us permission to share your progress, we immediately honored your request to remove your pictures and videos from our Instagram. 

Please understand that fulfilling this request meant permanently deleting many posts that featured other members and cherished community memories. We did this out of respect for your wishes despite the impact on our digital archive. 

We are proud of the work you put in over the years at CrossFit OZP and sincerely wish you the best on your health and wellness journey. 

Best Regards, 

The CrossFit OZP Team

Returning to fitness after having a baby is such a big step, and it means a lot to know you feel supported and met exactly where you’re at.

So happy to have you with us!

10065666245731145299.name: Janelle Pitterson
10065666245731145299.text:
Walking into CrossFit for the first time, I truly didn’t know what to expect, but from the moment I stepped into Dean CrossFit, it felt less like a gym and more like walking into a family you didn’t know you had yet.

There’s an immediate warmth in the space. People are open, kind, and generous with what they know. As someone completely new, even the small things like where equipment lives, how the class flows, and what you’re responsible for can feel intimidating, but no one made it feel that way. Instead, there was a sense of community, encouragement, and shared effort that made me feel welcome right away.

Coach Juan was my very first introduction to CrossFit, and I truly couldn’t have asked for a better one. From day one, he made the experience feel approachable and supportive.
When I arrived early for my second class, he took time--before the workout even began--to walk me through positioning, breathing, and technique, especially for deadlifts. He explained what I should be paying attention to in my own body so I could move safely and confidently. Injury prevention was clearly a priority for him, not just something mentioned in passing.

Juan has a calm, grounding presence, but he doesn’t let you coast. He pushes you to meet your best effort while still honoring your body. Even though the class is group-based, his coaching feels individualized. He’s present, attentive, and genuinely invested in seeing people succeed not just get through the workout.

By my second class, with instruction from Chris as well, I could see how consistent and intentional the coaching is at Dean CrossFit. Chris has an incredible ability to spot small details, correct form, and help you tap into strength you didn’t even realize you had. That’s truly his gift! I ended up deadlifting 20 lbs heavier than I ever thought possible at the start of the workout. I felt challenged, supported, and genuinely encouraged every step of the way--not just by the coaches, but by the entire class.

Dean CrossFit gives you more than a great workout (and you definitely leave feeling accomplished). It gives you community, thoughtful coaching, and a space where you feel cared for from the moment you walk in. As someone new, that mattered deeply to me and it’s the reason I’m excited to keep coming back. I guess, I'm a crossfit girl now!

However, I can’t say enough great things about my experience at Dean. This gym stands out above the rest. Welcoming, knowledgeable, and inclusive from the minute I walked in. If you’re local, join. If you’re in town visiting, drop in. I will definitely be back next time I’m in town!

10474770528045829329.name: Barrett House
10474770528045829329.text: Here is my attempt at a testimonial, if I could ever tell someone why they should start doing crossfit or just getting in better shape in general: it's so that they can travel, and particularly in the way I've been traveling the past couple of weeks. I have been thanking my past self for making the decision at the beginning of the year to 1) stop drinking 2) start exercising and eating clean again and 3) joining Crossfit Queens this last summer. I've traveled and taken trips before -- although this has certainly been the biggest, most real trip I've ever undertaken -- but that was when I was younger and invincible (or at least felt invincible). I celebrated my 37th birthday last week in Spain and I put these somewhat old bones through the ringer. Traveling can be a physically taxing activity, especially when approached with a wild mentality: unsure of where I'd be sleeping some nights, lugging my life around on my back from accommodation to accommodation, city to city, country to country, running to catch trains and planes, exploring new areas, doing handstands on the beach to impress some girls, racing my buddy in the ocean, even simple tasks like climbing in and out of baths without slipping and falling, or crawling in and out of a bunk bed in a hostel dorm room. The fear of being stitched up while on the road because of a stupid injury has grown as I've gotten older but I wasn't as concerned this trip because I'd been taking better care of myself. Stretching and lifting and running allowed me to really get after it these last couple of weeks. I wanted to find affiliates to drop into but there was always something to do, somewhere to go, or just necessary moments of rest. But I did manage to stretch and do press ups here and there (helped me stay zen when I was trying to sort out a flight change on the phone). Being complemented by friends from almost a decade ago because of how I looked, being able to dance all night at my friend's wedding, and at his wedding after party, and other than feeling tired from the madness I actually felt pretty great and I know that joining up and going to classes is a very big part of that. I was able to travel to Poland, Germany and Spain, go all day, very little sleep, last one to crash, first one to rise and it's because I was in better shape than I was last year. And now there are plans in the works for a big trip stateside in April and I'm immensely excited for the progress I hope to make between now and then. Back off the booze (Polish wedding and meeting up with old friends, had to get some pints in), eat clean and stretch, and try to really push myself during upcoming classes to maximize what I think I could be. The ultimate goal will be the ability to continue to travel in this manner for as long as I can, and being fit is key. Long ramble, but wanted to give an update, and to say thank you to all of the great coaches for helping me be better prepared for what was a trip of a lifetime. I'll be back in class next week. Definitely want to stay on this path

15530134556607004018.text: I was visiting family and did a drop-in visit to Cal harbor CrossFit. Wonderful place. Very friendly people. Excellent and and welcoming coaches.  I'll definitely go back again if I'm in town. I've posted today's WOD

15530134556607004018.name: José Roberto Alava guerrero
15530134556607004018.text: Hola soy de Ecuador y en mi país entrene en varios crossfit pero la comunidad de Cow Harbor Crossfit es increíble los profesores esta pendiente en ti que no falles me encanta entrenar CHC 100% recomendado 💪
15530134556607004018.textTranslated: Hi, I'm from Ecuador and I've trained at several CrossFit gyms in my country, but the Cow Harbor CrossFit community is incredible. The instructors are very attentive and make sure you don't let me down. I love training at CHC. 100% recommended 💪

15530134556607004018.name: Justin Oakley
15530134556607004018.text: I did two drop-ins here while visiting from Brooklyn and the classes were great! The WODs were fun and paced well. The coaches were very helpful and interactive. The members in my class also had great vibes! I will definitely be back whenever I'm in the area.

1719689488492743673.name: Ryan Michael
1719689488492743673.text: The community is supportive and kind, the couches are efficient yet take the time to engage with you one on one at whatever level you're at, also the on-boarding process is very helpful and structured so getting into the groove of things wasn't overwhelming at all. In the last year and a half I've lost over a hundred pounds and I'm now in the best shape of my life. Just one day at a time, and I have Bridge & Tunnel to thank!!!!

1719689488492743673.name: Josh Cameron
1719689488492743673.text: These coaches and people are great. It can be so hard to find a good gym. This is my second round here and happy I came back.  Cheers to the whole team and thanks for the push.

1719689488492743673.name: Kewsi Burgess
1719689488492743673.text:
Dropped in on the 7am class. It was well attended with friendly group of athletes and an energetic coach. Great programming-
I died during the workout, but regained consciousness just in time to write this review.
1719689488492743673.responseFromOwnerText: 😂 Thank you Kewsi! We were happy to have you. Looking forward to coming back again. Happy New Year 🎊

9286338271438476088.name: Laura Royse
9286338271438476088.text: Fun kids classes. My son loved it!

9286338271438476088.name: Jenny Chiu
9286338271438476088.text: I took my first class today with Juliana.  She’s great! Very attentive and helped make sure I was doing all of the moves properly.  Great energy and kept the class fun.  Overall, just a really great person (and extremely fit!)
